title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
english: Donald Trump has promised that every American will receive $5,000 if his party succeeds in the upcoming midterm elections. However, the proposal faces significant scrutiny because he has not explained how it would be funded and critics have questioned its overall legality. Many opponents have dismissed the plan as an empty campaign promise, especially given the estimated $1.3 trillion price tag.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ በመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ካሸነፈ እያንዳንዱ አሜሪካዊ 5,000 ዶላር እንደሚቀበል ቃል ገብተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የዚህ እቅድ የገንዘብ ምንጭ ያልታወቀ በመሆኑ እና ህጋዊነት ላይ ጥያቄዎች በመነሳታቸው ጉዳዩ አወዛጋቢ ሆኗል። ተቃዋሚዎች ይህ ሀሳብ 1.3 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር ወጪ የሚጠይቅ በመሆኑ ትርጉም የለሽ የፖለቲካ ቃል መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Donald Traamp paartiin isaa filannoo dhufu irratti injifannoo yoo argate lammiileen Ameerikaa hundi doolaara 5,000 akka argatan waadaa galeera. Ta'us, karoora kanaaf maallaqni eessa akka dhufu waan hin ibsamneef akkasumas seera qabeessummaan isaa shakkamaa waan ta'eef falmii guddaa kaaseera. Morkattoonni karoori kun baasii doolaara tiriliyoona 1.3 kan gaafatu waan ta'eef, waadaa lafaa ka'u qofa akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
english: A power struggle has emerged in Uganda's Tooro Kingdom following the death of King Oyo, the world's youngest monarch, at age 34. Royal elders have appointed a 56-year-old television presenter as the successor, but the late king's family insists he left a will naming his young son as the heir. Amidst this dispute, the Queen Mother has reported that the family is being restricted by security forces and has pleaded for a peaceful burial for the late king.
amharic: የዓለማችን ወጣት ንጉሥ የነበሩት የቶሮው ንጉሥ ኦዮ በ34 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት መለየታቸውን ተከትሎ በዩጋንዳው የቶሮ መንግሥት የሥልጣን ሽኩቻ ተቀስቅሷል። የቤተ መንግሥቱ ሽማግሌዎች የቴሌቪዥን ጋዜጠኛ የሆኑትን ልዑል ኤድዋርድ ሩኪዲን ተተኪ አድርገው ቢሰይሙም፣ የሟቹ ቤተሰቦች ግን ንጉሡ በኑዛዜ ልጃቸውን እንደሰየሙ ይናገራሉ። ንግሥት እናቱ ቤተሰቦቻቸው በጦር ኃይሎች ተከበው እንደ ታሰሩ በመግለጽ፣ የልጇ የቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓት በሰላም እንዲከናወን ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: mootummaa Tooro kan Yuugaandaa keessatti, mootichi dargaggeessi Oyo waggaa 34tti du'uusaanii hordofee wal dhabdee aangoo mudateera. Maanguddoonni gosaa gabaasaa televizhinii umriin isaanii 56 ta'e bakka buusuuf filatanis, maatiin mootichaa garuu inni ilma isaa akka inni mootii ta'u dhaalaan akka kaa'e dubbatu. Haati mootichaa, mootichi du'anii awwaalamuusaanii dura maatiin isaanii humnoota waraanaan ugguramuusaanii ibsuun, sirni awwaalchaa nagaan akka raawwatamu gaafataniiru.

title: Houthis advance along Yemen’s southern Red Sea coast
english: Houthi rebels supported by Iran are moving quickly across Yemen's southern Red Sea coastline. This military progress poses a significant threat to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which serves as a vital passage for global trade. Controlling this area would grant the group increased strategic influence over international shipping lanes.
amharic: በኢራን የሚደገፉት የሁቲ አማጽያን በየመን ቀይ ባህር ጠረፍ አካባቢ በፍጥነት እየገሰገሱ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ለአለም አቀፍ ንግድ እጅግ ወሳኝ በሆነው የባብ አል-ማንደብ የባህር መተላለፊያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። አካባቢውን መቆጣጠራቸውም አማጽያኑ በባህር መስመሮች ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ በእጅጉ እንዲጨምር ያደርገዋል።
oromo: Houthiwwan deeggarsa Iran argatan, qarqara galaana diimaa biyya Yemen keessatti ariitiin gadi bahuun bakkeewwan hedduu to'achaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun karaa daldala idil-addunyaa kan ta'e Bab el-Mandeb irratti balaa cimaa uumee jira. Houthiwwan bakka kana to'achuun isaanii dhiibbaa inni karaa galaanaa irratti qabu akka dabaluu danda'u himameera.

title: Manchester United scouted Mbappe but didn’t sign him, says Ryan Giggs
english: Former Manchester United coach Ryan Giggs revealed that the club had the opportunity to sign Kylian Mbappe when he was just a 15-year-old rising star at Monaco. After receiving a tip from a local scout in 2015, Giggs and his colleague watched the youngster and were deeply impressed by his talent. However, despite their recommendation, the club’s scouting department ultimately chose not to pursue a deal for the future superstar.
amharic: የቀድሞው የማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ አሰልጣኝ ሪያን ጊግስ ክለቡ በፈረንጆቹ 2015 በሞናኮ ይጫወት የነበረውን የ15 ዓመቱን ታዳጊ ኪሊያን ምባፔን የማስፈረም እድል እንደነበረው ገለጹ። ከፈረንሳይ በደረሳቸው ጥቆማ መሰረት ጊግስ እና ባልደረቦቹ ተጫዋቹን በአካል ተመልክተው በጣም እንደተደነቁ ተናግረዋል። ነገር ግን የክለቡ የስካውቲንግ ክፍል ጉዳዩን በመተው የወደፊቱን ኮከብ ለማስፈረም የሚያስችል እርምጃ ሳይወስድ ቀርቷል።
oromo: Leenjisaan duraanii Manchester United Ryan Giggs akka jedhetti, kilabichi Kylian Mbappe umriin isaa waggaa 15 turetti Monakootti yeroo taphatu isa fuudhuuf carraa akka qabaate ibseera. Bara 2015tti qorataa tokko irraa gorsa erga argatee booda, Giggs fi gargaartonni isaa dargaggeessa kana erga ilaalanii booda dandeettii isaa baay'ee dinqisiifataniiru. Ta'us, gorsi isaanii kun fudhatama argatee kilabichi dorgomaa guddaa ta'uuf deemu kana bituuf tarkaanfii fudhachuu hin dandeenye.

title: The Trump loyalty test: Will his supporters ever disagree with him?
english: Donald Trump is serving as the primary focus of the Republican Party's inaugural midterm convention. The event acts as a significant rallying point for party members looking to secure their control over Congress. The gathering highlights the strong influence Trump continues to wield over his supporters within the political movement.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ የመጀመሪያ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ስብሰባ ዋና ትኩረት ሆነው ቀርበዋል። ይህ ዝግጅት በኮንግረስ ውስጥ ያላቸውን የበላይነት ለማስጠበቅ ለሚጥሩ የፓርቲው አባላት ትልቅ የሞራል ድጋፍ ሰጪ መድረክ ሆኗል። ስብሰባው ትራምፕ በደጋፊዎቻቸው እና በፓርቲው እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ያላቸውን ከፍተኛ ተጽእኖ ያሳያል።
oromo: Donald Tiraampin walga'ii gidduu waggaa kan Paartii Rippaabilikaanotaa jalqabaa irratti xiyyeeffannaa guddaa argataniiru. Walga'iin kun miseensonni paartichaa mana maree keessatti aangoosaanii akka eeggatan jajjabeessuuf gargaara. Ta'iin kunis Tiraampin hordoftootasaanii fi sochii siyaasaa keessatti dhiibbaa guddaa qaban kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Hundreds of thousands lack adequate shelter at Sudan’s Tawila camp
english: Hundreds of thousands of displaced people at the Tawila camp in Sudan are facing a severe shelter crisis as aid remains insufficient to meet their needs. While some tents have been provided by international organizations, they fall far short of what is required to house the massive population currently threatened by the rainy season and potential famine. Local officials are calling for increased aid deliveries and improved border access to provide essential food and medicine to these struggling communities.
amharic: በሱዳን ታዊላ መጠለያ ካምፕ የሚገኙ በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተፈናቃዮች በቂ መጠለያ ባለማግኘታቸው ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ ድርጅቶች የድንኳን ድጋፍ ቢሰጡም፣ ያለው መጠለያ ለተፈናቃዮች ብዛት እጅግ አነስተኛ በመሆኑ ዝናባማው ወቅት እና የምግብ እጥረት ህይወታቸውን አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል። የክልሉ አስተዳደር ለተጎጂዎች የምግብ እና የመድኃኒት አቅርቦት እንዲጨምር እና የድንበር መግቢያዎች እንዲከፈቱ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Buufata Tawilaa kan sudaan keessatti argamu keessatti namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa’aman gargaarsa ga’aa fi iddoo jireenyaa dhabuun rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru. Dhaabbileen gargaarsaa dunkaana muraasa dhaabanis, lakkoofsi kun namoota kuma dhibbaan lakkaa’amaniif waan hin geenyeef, jiini roobaa fi hanqinni nyaataa lubbuu isaanii balaaf saaxilee jira. Hogganoonni naannichaa gargaarsi nyaataa fi qorichaa akka dabalu akkasumas karaaleen daangaa gargaarsaf akka banaman gaafataniiru.

title: At least 25 dead after cargo ship catches fire in China
english: A fire aboard a foreign-flagged cargo ship undergoing repairs at the Qingdao port in China has resulted in at least 25 deaths. Out of the 42 people on board, 12 were evacuated safely and five others are receiving hospital care. Chinese leadership has ordered a thorough investigation into the incident and emphasized the need for immediate search and rescue efforts.
amharic: ቻይና በሚገኘው የቺንግዳኦ ወደብ ለጥገና ቆሞ በነበረ የውጭ ሀገር የጭነት መርከብ ላይ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ 25 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በመርከቧ ላይ ከነበሩት 42 ሰዎች መካከል 12ቱ በሰላም ሲወጡ፣ አምስቱ ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው በህክምና ላይ ይገኛሉ። የቻይና ከፍተኛ አመራሮች በአደጋው ዙሪያ ጥልቅ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ እና የነፍስ አድን ስራው በአስቸኳይ እንዲቀጥል ትእዛዝ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Buufata doonii Qingdao kan Chaayinaa keessatti doonii fe'umsaa biyya alaa tokko kan suphamaa jirtu irratti ibidda ka'een lubbuun namoota 25 ol darbeera. Namoota 42 dooniittii keessa turan keessaa 12 nagaatti kan ba'an yoo ta'u, shan ammoo miidhaa irra ga'een hospitaala galanii yaalamaa jiru. Hooggantoonni Chaayinaa rakkoo kana irratti qorannoo cimaa akka taasisan fi hojiin barbaacha fi oolchuu namootaa ariitiin akka itti fufu ajajaniiru.

title: Trump says every adult American would get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
english: President Donald Trump has promised a $5,000 payment to every American adult if the Republican Party secures control of both houses of Congress in the upcoming midterms. While the plan aims to encourage voter turnout, critics have questioned its legal feasibility and the massive $1.3 trillion price tag. The proposal remains controversial, especially as the administration struggles with rising living costs and global oil supply issues linked to the ongoing conflict with Iran.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሪፐብሊካኖች በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ የኮንግረስ ቤቶችን ከተቆጣጠሩ፣ ለእያንዳንዱ አሜሪካዊ አዋቂ 5,000 ዶላር እንደሚሰጡ ቃል ገብተዋል። ይህ እቅድ የምርጫ ድምጽን ለመጨመር የታለመ ቢሆንም፣ የ1.3 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር ወጪ እንደሚጠይቅ በመጠቆም እና የህግ ተፈጻሚነቱን በመጠራጠር ተችቷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በአሜሪካ ያለው የኑሮ ውድነት እና ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ግጭት በነዳጅ ዋጋ ላይ እያደረሰ ባለው ተጽዕኖ ሳቢያ፣ ሃሳቡ ከፍተኛ ክርክር አስነስቷል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp, paartiin Riippabliikanii filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa dhufuun mana maree lameenuu to'annoo isaanii jala oolchuu yoo danda'an, lammiilee Ameerikaa hundaaf doolaara 5,000 kenna jedhanii waadaa galaniiru. Karoorri kun sagalee filannoo dabaluuf kan qophaaye ta'us, baasii tiriliyoona 1.3 gaafatuu fi seera qabeessummaa isaa irratti shakkiiwwan ka'aniiru. Haalli kun jireenya idilee irratti gatiin dabaluu fi waldhabdee Iraan waliin jiruun walqabatee gatiin boba'aa dabaluu isaa waliin walqabatee mormii guddaa kaasuu danda'eera.

title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
english: Donald Trump stated that the conflict with Iran will likely persist until the November midterm elections conclude. He claims that Iranian officials are holding out until then, hoping for a change in US leadership, and expects oil prices to drop once the situation is resolved. Despite his previous predictions of a short war, the ongoing instability has negatively impacted his approval ratings and caused domestic economic strain.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ጦርነት እስከ ህዳር ወር የአሜሪካ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ድረስ እንደሚቀጥል ተናግረዋል። የኢራን መንግስት በአሜሪካ የፖለቲካ ለውጥ እንደሚኖር በማሰብ ጦርነቱን እያራዘመ እንደሆነ እና ምርጫው እንዳለቀ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንደሚቀንስ ገልጸዋል። ምንም እንኳን ጦርነቱ በአጭር ጊዜ እንደሚጠናቀቅ ተስፋ ሰጥተው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የቆየው ውጥረት በፕሬዝዳንቱ ተወዳጅነት እና በሀገር ውስጥ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ አሉታዊ ተፅእኖ አሳድሯል።
oromo: Donald Trump walitti buiinsi Iran wajjin jiru hamma filannoo biyyoolessa Ameerikaa kan ji'a Sadaasaatti xumuramuutti kan itti fufu ta'uu ibseera. Mootummaan Iran jijjiirama siyaasaa Ameerikaa eeggachaa akka jiru fi filannoon erga darbee booda gatiin boba'aa akka hir'atu dubbateera. Walitti buiinsi kun yeroo gabaabaatti xumurama jedhee abdachaa kan ture ta'us, yeroo dheeraa fudhachuun isaa jaalatamummaa isaa fi diinagdee biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa uumeera.

title: Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on $2,000 first folding iPhone
english: Apple’s new CEO, John Ternus, has unveiled the company's first foldable smartphone, named the 'Duo,' marking the most significant design shift for the iPhone in two decades. This innovative device functions like a compact tablet when opened and a standard phone when folded, aiming to improve upon existing foldable market options. With a starting price of $1,999, it represents a bold and expensive new direction for the tech giant under its new leadership.
amharic: የአፕል አዲሱ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጆን ተርነስ ኩባንያው ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የፈጠረውን 'ዱኦ' የተሰኘ መታጠፊያ ስልክ አስተዋውቀዋል። ይህ መሳሪያ ሲከፈት እንደ ትንሽ ታብሌት የሚያገለግል ሲሆን፣ ሲታጠፍ ደግሞ እንደ ተለመደው ስልክ ያገለግላል። ስልኩ በገበያ ላይ ካሉ ሌሎች መታጠፊያ ስልኮች የተለየ እና የተሻሻለ ቅርፅ እንዳለው የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ዋጋውም ከ1,999 ዶላር ይጀምራል።
oromo: Hogganaan haaraan Apple John Ternus, bilbila Apple kan jalqabaa kan dachaatu 'Duo' jedhamu gadi dhiiseera. Meeshaan kun yeroo banamu akka taableetii xiqqaa kan hojjetu yoo ta'u, yeroo dachaatu immoo akka bilbila idilee tajaajila. Bilbilli kun kan biroo irraa adda ta'uuf kan qophaa'e yoo ta'u, gatiin isaa $1,999 irraa kan jalqabuufi jijjiirama guddaa Apple keessatti mul'ateedha.

title: ‘Gone in a blink’: Nepal floods sweep away Indian workers who built hotels
english: In late August, devastating flash floods in Syafrubesi, Nepal, destroyed the town and claimed the lives of numerous people, including migrant workers from India. While many residents and workers fled to higher ground as the water engulfed the area, thousands remain missing and over a thousand bodies have been recovered. Survivors who had spent years building the town's infrastructure watched helplessly as their work and homes were wiped away in moments.
amharic: በነሐሴ ወር መጨረሻ በኔፓል ስያፍሩቤሲ ከተማ የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ አደጋ መላውን ከተማ በማጥለቅለቅ በህንድ የመጡ ስደተኛ ሠራተኞችን ጨምሮ ብዙዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። አብዛኛው ነዋሪና ሠራተኛ ጎርፉ ሲመጣ ወደ ተራራማ ቦታዎች በመሸሽ ቢተርፉም፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች አሁንም የደረሱበት አልታወቀም፤ ከሺህ በላይ አስከሬኖችም ተገኝተዋል። ለዓመታት የከተማዋን መሠረተ ልማት ሲገነቡ የቆዩት በሕይወት የተረፉት ሰዎች፣ የለፉበት ሥራና ቤታቸው በአይን ጥቅሻ ሲጠፋ በዓይናቸው ማየት ችለዋል።
oromo: Dhuma ji'a Hagayyaatti magaalota Neepaali keessatti balaan lolaa tasaa uumame magaalattii guutummaatti barbadeesseera. Balaa kanaan hojjettoota godaantota Hindii irraa dhufan dabalatee namoonni hedduun lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Namoonni hedduun lolaa sana jalaa ooluuf gara tulluu yoo baqatanis, namoonni kumaatamaatti lakkaa'aman ammallee bakka bu'an hin beekamu; reeffi namoota kuma tokko ol ta'us argameera. Namoonni waggoota hedduuf guddina magaalattii irratti hojjechaa turan fi balaa kanaan oolanii hafne, manni fi ijaarsi isaan waggoota dheeraaf hojjetan yeroo gabaabaa keessatti lolaan hatamee yommuu deemu ilaaluun isaanii isaan miidheera.

title: Enrique hails Dembele, praises Toure after PSG’s win over Bratislava
english: Paris Saint-Germain started their Champions League campaign with a dominant 6-1 victory against Slovan Bratislava. Coach Luis Enrique praised Ousmane Dembele for his brilliant performance, which included two goals and two assists. Despite the heavy defeat, Enrique also commended Yaya Toure for his tactical approach as the first African coach to lead a team in this competition.
amharic: ፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜን በቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ውድድሩ ስሎቫን ብራቲስላቫን 6 ለ 1 በማሸነፍ ጉዞውን በድል ጀምሯል። አሰልጣኝ ሉዊስ ኤንሪኬ ሁለት ግቦችን ያስቆጠረውንና ሁለት የግብ እድሎችን የፈጠረውን ኦስማን ደምቤለን ብቃት አድንቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን የያያ ቱሬ ቡድን ቢሸነፍም፣ በውድድሩ የተሳተፈ የመጀመሪያው አፍሪካዊ አሰልጣኝ በመሆኑ ኤንሪኬ አክብሮታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Paaris Saint-Jeermeen injifannoo guddaa 6 fi 1 ta'een tapha Chaampiyoons Liigii isaa jalqabeera. Leenjisaan Paaris Luwiis Enrike taphataa Ousmane Dembele gahee inni tapha kana irratti taphateef jecha baay'ee galateeffataniiru. Tapha kana irratti garuu gareen Yayaa Tuuree mo'atamus, Enrike leenjisaa kana kan kabajaman yoo ta'u, inni leenjisaa Afrikaa isa jalqabaa dorgommii kana irratti garee leenjisu ta'uun isaa ibsameera.

title: Russian attacks kill 7 in Ukraine as Kyiv targets gas plants deep in Arctic
english: Russian strikes in Ukraine have resulted in the deaths of seven people across the Mykolaiv and Sumy regions, while wounding dozens more. In retaliation, Ukraine executed a long-range drone strike on an industrial facility in Russia's remote Arctic territory. This event marks one of the furthest reaching attacks conducted by Kyiv since the start of the conflict.
amharic: በዩክሬን በሚገኙ ሚኮላይቭ እና ሱሚ ክልሎች በተፈጸሙ የሩሲያ ጥቃቶች ሰባት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ለዚህ ምላሽ ዩክሬን በሩሲያ አርክቲክ ክልል ውስጥ በሚገኝ የኢንዱስትሪ ማዕከል ላይ የረጅም ርቀት ድሮን ጥቃት አድርሳለች። ይህ ጥቃት ኪየቭ ከጦርነቱ መጀመሪያ አንስቶ እስካሁን ካደረሰችው እጅግ ርቀት ያለው ጥቃት ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Humni Raashiyaa biyya Yukireen keessatti haleellaa geggeesseen namoonni torba ajjeefamanii, hedduun immoo madaa'aniiru. Kana booda, Yukireen mormii ishee ibsuuf naannoo Arktik kan Raashiyaa keessatti iddoo indastirii tokko irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) geggeessiteetti. Haleellaan kun, waraanni erga jalqabee asii asitti Yukireen iddoo fagoo akkanaa irratti haleellaa raawwatte keessaa isa tokko.

title: Israeli attacks kill at least four Palestinians in northern Gaza
english: Israeli military airstrikes in northern Gaza's Beit Lahiya town resulted in the deaths of a Palestinian couple and their two young daughters. These attacks occurred despite an ongoing ceasefire agreement that has been in place since October 2025. This incident is part of a broader conflict that has caused massive casualties and widespread destruction across the Gaza Strip.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ጋዛ ቤይት ላሂያ ከተማ በእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በተፈጸመ የቦምብ ጥቃት አንድ ጥንድ እና ሁለት ልጆቻቸው ተገድለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ከጥቅምት 2025 ጀምሮ በሥራ ላይ ባለው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ ቢሆንም የተፈጸመ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በጋዛ ሰርጥ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እና የሰዎች ህልፈት እያስከተለ ካለው ሰፊ ግጭት አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el kutaa kaaba Gaazaatti, magaalaa Beet Laahiyaatti weerara xiyyaaraan geggeesseen abbaa warraa fi haadha warraa akkasumas ijoollee isaanii lama ajjeeseera. Miidhaan kun kan raawwatame, waligalteen dhaabbii waraanaa baatii Onkololeessa 2025 irraa eegalee ture jiraatusi. Kuni hunda dabalatee, waraana Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbaa jiraachuu fi miidhaan guddaan geessifamaa jiraachuu agarsiisa.

title: Japan baseball great and atomic bomb survivor Isao Harimoto dies aged 86
english: Japanese baseball icon Isao Harimoto has passed away at the age of 86. A survivor of the Hiroshima atomic bombing, he overcame a childhood injury to become the all-time hits leader in Japanese professional baseball. Inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame in 1990, he remains remembered for his incredible skill and storied 23-season career.
amharic: የጃፓን የቤዝቦል ኮከብ ኢሳኦ ሃሪሞቶ በ86 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። የሂሮሺማ የኒውክሌር ቦምብ ጥቃት የተረፉት ሃሪሞቶ፣ በልጅነታቸው በደረሰባቸው ጉዳት አልበገሩም እና በጃፓን ቤዝቦል ታሪክ ከፍተኛውን የኳስ መምታት ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግበዋል። እ.ኤ.አ. በ1990 ወደ ቤዝቦል ዝነኞች አዳራሽ የገቡት አትሌቱ፣ ለ23 ዓመታት በቆየው የሙያ ህይወታቸው ትልቅ አድናቆት ነበራቸው።
oromo: Leencichi ispoortii beysbolii Jaappaan Isao Harimoto waggaa 86tti lubbuun darbeera. Miidhaa roobii atoomikii Hiroshiimaa irraa kan oole namichi kun, miidhaa ijoollummaatti irra ga'e hunda dandamatee seenaa beysbolii Jaappaan keessatti rekodii olaanaa galmeessiseera. Bara 1990 galmee kabajaa beysbolii (Hall of Fame) keessatti kan galmaa'e yoo ta'u, hojii isaa waggaa 23 keessatti sadarkaa beekamtii guddaa argateera.

title: Family of four killed in Israeli strike in northern Gaza
english: An Israeli military airstrike in northern Gaza resulted in the deaths of a family of four, including two children aged eight and twelve. Local medical officials confirmed that the tragedy occurred after the attack struck their home in the Beit Lahia area. The victims' remains were recovered by rescue workers shortly after the incident.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ጋዛ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት የሁለት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ የአንድ ቤተሰብ አራት አባላት ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ የቤይት ላሂያ አካባቢ በሚገኝ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ ያነጣጠረ መሆኑን የህክምና ባለሙያዎች አረጋግጠዋል። በደረሰው ጥቃት የ12 እና የ8 ዓመት ህጻናት ህይወት ማለፉም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gammoojjii gaazaatti miilaan rukutamee namoota afur, kanneen keessaa ijoollee lama dabalatee, ajjeeseera. Ogeeyyonni fayyaa akka ibsanitti, rukutaan kun mana jireenyaa naannoo Beit Lahia keessatti argamu irratti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, ijoolleen lubbuun isaanii darbe umurii isaanii waggaa 12 fi 8 akka ta'e beekameera.

title: Ali al-Taher: What Israel’s 'operational control' of the hill really means for Hezbollah and Lebanon
english: The Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon has become a key strategic point of contention between Hezbollah and Israeli forces. Unlike its usual guerrilla tactics of avoiding fixed positions, Hezbollah initially treated this hill as a vital location to be defended due to its underground facilities and tactical command over the region. Losing control of this ridge allows Israel to monitor Nabatieh and Iqlim al-Tuffah, effectively reversing the area's power dynamics and surveillance capabilities.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚገኘው የአሊ አል-ታሄር ኮረብታ በሂዝቦላህ እና በእስራኤል ኃይሎች መካከል ትልቅ ስትራቴጂያዊ የጦርነት ነጥብ ሆኗል። ሂዝቦላህ ከተለመደው የረቀቀ የጦር ስልቱ በተለየ መልኩ፣ ይህንን ስፍራ ከመሬት በታች ባሉት ወታደራዊ መሠረተ ልማቶች ምክንያት ለመከላከል ወስኖ ነበር። የእስራኤል ጦር የዚህን ስፍራ ቁጥጥር መያዙ በናባቲህ እና በአካባቢው ላይ የክትትል የበላይነት እንዲኖራት በማስቻል፣ የጦርነቱን ሚዛን ለሂዝቦላህ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Gaarreen Ali al-Taher jedhamu kan kibba Libaanos argamu, humnoota Hizbollah fi Israa'el gidduutti dirree waraanaaf bakka murteessaa ta'eera. Hizbollah, iddoo dhaabbataa qabachuu irraa of qusachuun baratamaa ta'us, gaarreen kun bakka buufataalee jala-lafaa qabuuf jecha akka bakka itti gaafatamuutti ilaale. Israa'el gaarree kana to'achuun ishee, naannoo Nabatieh fi Iqlim al-Tuffah irratti hordoffii cimaa akka taasiftuufi humna waraanaa ishee akka jabeessitu gargaareera.

title: Settlement trade ban: Burnham succeeds in weeks where Starmer failed for years
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has introduced a ban on trade with Israeli settlements, marking a significant shift in foreign policy just seven weeks into his term. This move aligns Britain with the 2024 International Court of Justice ruling regarding the illegality of the settlements, highlighting a contrast with the inaction of his predecessor, Keir Starmer. Meanwhile, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch faces criticism for siding with Israel against this policy, a stance that has sparked a major political divide.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ስልጣን ከያዙ ሰባት ሳምንታት በኋላ በእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች ላይ የንግድ እገዳ ጥለዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የ2024ቱን የዓለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ በመከተል ብሪታንያ የቀድሞውን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኬይር ስታርመርን አቋም በመቀየር ከዓለም አቀፍ ህግ ጋር እንድትጣጣም ያደርጋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ የተቃዋሚው መሪ ኬሚ ቤደኖክ ይህንን ውሳኔ በመቃወም ከእስራኤል ጎን መቆማቸው በብሪታንያ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ትልቅ መከፋፈል ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Biritaniyaa Andy Burnham erga aangoo qabatanii torban torba booda, daldala naannawaa Israa'elitti argaman irratti dhorkaa kaa'aniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun murtee Mana Murtii Addunyaa bara 2024 kan naannawaan sun seeraan ala ta'uu ibsu waliin kan wal simatu yoo ta'u, mootummaa kanaan duraa kan Keir Starmer irraa adda baasa. Gama biraatiin, hogganaan mormituu Kemi Badenoch tarkaanfii mootummaa kana mormuudhaan Israa'el gargaaruun isaanii siyaasa Biritaniyaa keessatti walitti bu'iinsa guddaa uumeera.

title: In Syria's Daraa, water is life - and today the land is parched
english: Lake al-Muzayrib in southern Syria, once a vital water source for agriculture and fishing, has completely dried up due to prolonged drought and poor resource management. Former fisherman Abdul-Munaf al-Masri and his community have suffered greatly, losing their livelihoods as the region faces an unprecedented water collapse. This environmental disaster has forced many local workers to abandon their traditional way of life and find new jobs just to survive.
amharic: በደቡብ ሶሪያ የሚገኘው የአል-ሙዛይሪብ ሐይወት በረጅም ጊዜ ድርቅ እና በውኃ ሀብት አያያዝ ጉድለት ምክንያት ሙሉ በሙሉ ደርቋል። ቀደም ሲል በአካባቢው የነበሩ አሳ አጥማጆች እንደ አብዱል-ሙናፍ አል-ማስሪ ያሉት ሰዎች የኑሮ ምንጫቸውን በማጣታቸው ለከፍተኛ ችግር ተጋልጠዋል። ይህ አስከፊ የውኃ እጥረት በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ የነበረውን ባህላዊ የኑሮ ዘይቤ በማስተጓጎል፣ ብዙዎች ለህልውና ሲሉ ወደ ሌላ ሥራ ለመሰማራት ተገደዋል።
oromo: Haroon Al-Muzayrib kan kibba Suuriyaatti argamu, sababa hongee yeroo dheeraa fi itti fayyadama bishaanirratti hanqina jiruun guutummaatti gogee jira. Qonnonni fi qurxummii qabattoonni naannichaa akka Abdul-Munaf al-Masri fa'i, madda galii isaanii waan dhabaniif miidhaan cimaan irra ga'ee jira. Balaan kun jiraattota naannichaa jireenya isaanii isa kanaan duraa akka dhiisan fi akka jiraataniif gara hojii biraatti akka seenan isaan dirqisiisee jira.

title: Pakistan, Turkey back Arab endorsement of UK's settlement sanctions
english: Pakistan and Turkey have officially expressed their support for an Arab-led statement that endorses the United Kingdom’s decision to sanction products from illegal Israeli settlements. During a phone call, the foreign ministers of both nations discussed regional stability and reaffirmed their commitment to ongoing cooperation with Saudi Arabia and Egypt. Additionally, Pakistan's defense minister highlighted that a mutual defense agreement could be triggered if Saudi Arabia faces further military threats.
amharic: ፓኪስታን እና ቱርክ፣ ብሪታኒያ በሕገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ምርቶች ላይ የጣለችውን ማዕቀብ የሚደግፍ የአረብ አገራት የጋራ መግለጫ መደገፋቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሁለቱ አገራት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በስልክ ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ በቀጠናዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ ያላቸውን ትብብር አጠናክረው ለመቀጠል ተስማምተዋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ የፓኪስታን የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የተፈረመው የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተግባራዊ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Paakistaaniifi Turkii murtoo Biriiteen sochii naannoo Israa'el seeraan alaa ta'e irratti uggura kaa'uuf fudhatte kan deggeran ta'uusaanii ibsaniiru. Ministiroonni dhimmi alaa biyyoota lamaanii bilbiladhaan haasa'anii, nageenya naannichaa eeguufi biyyoota akka Sa'udii Arabiyaafi Masri wajjin walta'iinsasaanii cimsuuf waliigalaniiru. Kana malees, ministirri ittisa biyyaa Paakistaan, yoo Sa'udii Arabiyaa irratti weerarri raawwatame, waligalteen ittisaa isaan gidduutti mallatteeffame hojiirra ooluu akka danda'u ibsaniiru.

title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry
english: A passenger ferry traveling to the Philippine tourist destination of Coron caught fire on Wednesday evening, resulting in at least five deaths. Authorities are currently searching for 86 missing individuals, while 43 survivors have been rescued and taken to a nearby facility. Rescue operations are being severely hampered by dangerous weather conditions and strong sea currents that have caused the burning vessel to drift.
amharic: ወደ ፊሊፒንስ የቱሪስት መዳረሻ ኮሮን ሲጓዝ የነበረ የመንገደኞች መርከብ ረቡዕ ምሽት በእሳት መያዙን ተከትሎ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ባለሥልጣናት አሁንም 86 የጠፉ ሰዎችን እየፈለጉ ሲሆን 43 ሰዎች ታድገው ወደ ተዘጋጀላቸው መጠለያ ተወስደዋል። የነፍስ አድን ስራው በከባድ የአየር ሁኔታ እና መርከቧን ወደ ሌላ አቅጣጫ እየወሰደ ባለው ኃይለኛ የባህር ሞገድ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ችግር ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Dooniin abbaa manaa gara kutaa Filippiin kan taate Coron deemaa turte tokko roobii galgala ibiddan gubattee namoonni shan lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Aangoonni mootummaa namoota 86 bakka buuteen isaanii hin beekamne barbaacha irratti kan argaman yoo ta'u, namoonni 43 lubbuun baraarramanii gara bakka nageenyaa geeffamaniiru. Hojiin fayyinsaa haala qilleensa hamaa fi dhangala'aa bishaan galaanaa cimaa doonittiin akka naanna'u godheen gufata guddaa keessa galeera.

title: Five dead, dozens missing in Philippines ferry fire
english: A passenger ferry named M/V June Aster caught fire while traveling near the coast of Palawan in the Philippines, leaving at least five people dead. Rescuers have safely recovered over 40 individuals, but authorities report that 87 people are still missing. Search and rescue operations are currently underway to locate the remaining passengers and crew members from the vessel.
amharic: ኤም/ቪ ጁን አስቴር የተባለ የሳቢ ተሳፋሪ መርከብ በፊሊፒንስ ፓላዋን ጠረፍ አቅራቢያ በእሳት በመያዙ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ከ40 በላይ ሰዎችን ማዳን ቢችሉም፣ እስካሁን 87 ሰዎች የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። የጠፋውን ሰው ለማግኘት የፍለጋ እና የማዳን ስራዎች በአሁኑ ሰዓት በስፋት እየተካሄዱ ነው።
oromo: Markabii imaltootaa 'M/V June Aster' jedhamu kan biyya Filippiins naannoo Palawaanitti ibiddi qabatee, namoonni shan lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Humnoonni fayyisaa namoota 40 ol olchuuf kan danda'an ta'us, namoonni 87 ammallee eessa akka jiran hin beekamne. Hojiiwwan barbaachaafi fayyisaa namoota hafan argachuuf ammayyuu itti fufee jira.

title: Netanyahu to sue Haaretz over claims UAE warned him before October 7 attack
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is launching a lawsuit against the Haaretz newspaper following a report that claimed the UAE president warned him about the October 7, 2023, Hamas attack. Netanyahu dismissed the allegations as completely false and fabricated, stating he never received such a warning. The newspaper had alleged that UAE leader Mohammed bin Zayed contacted Netanyahu regarding intelligence about an impending threat, but the Prime Minister insists this account is untrue.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ፣ የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬትስ ከጥቅምት 7 ቀን 2023 የሃማስ ጥቃት አስቀድሞ አስጠንቅቀዋቸው እንደነበር የዘገበውን 'ሃአሬትዝ' የተባለውን ጋዜጣ ክስ ሊመሰርቱበት መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ኔታንያሁ ዘገባው ፍጹም ሐሰት እና የተፈጠረ ነው በማለት ያስተባበሉ ሲሆን፣ የሕግ ባለሙያዎቻቸውም በጋዜጣው ላይ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ አዘዋል። ጋዜጣው የኤምሬትሱ መሪ መሐመድ ቢን ዛይድ ስለ ጥቃቱ ለጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ በስልክ ነግረዋቸው እንደነበር ቢገልጽም፣ ኔታንያሁ ግን ይህንን ወሬ አጣጥለውታል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Nataanyaahuu, gabaasa gaazexaan Haarets jedhamu, pirezidaantiin UAE qophii haleellaa Hagayya 7, 2023 dura akeekkachiisa kennanii turan jechuun baase irratti himata banuuf akka qophaa'e ibsaniiru. Nataanyaahuun gabaasichi sobaafi namni ofiin kan uumeedha jedhanii kan morman yoo ta'u, abbootii seeraa isaaniis gaazexicha irratti tarkaanfii akka fudhatan ajajaniiru. Gaazexaan kun, hogganaan UAE Mohaammad biin Zaayed haleellaa dhufaa jiru ilaalchisee Nataanyaahuu gorsanii turan jedhee gabaasuus, mummichi ministeerichaa dubbiin kun dhugaa miti jechuun haalaniiru.

title: Why is Iran bombing Jordan’s Al-Azraq base?
english: Iran has recently intensified military strikes against the Muwaffaq Salti Air Base located near Al-Azraq, Jordan. Tehran considers this facility a primary target because it serves as a critical operational center for United States military forces in the region. These attacks reflect ongoing regional tensions and Iran's strategic efforts to challenge the American military presence.
amharic: ኢራን በቅርቡ በዮርዳኖስ አል-አዝራቅ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው ሙዋፋቅ ሳልቲ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃቷን አጠናክራለች። ቴህራን ይህንን ጣቢያ የአሜሪካ ጦር በክልሉ የሚጠቀምበት ዋና የኦፕሬሽን ማዕከል እንደመሆኑ መጠን ትክክለኛ ኢላማ አድርጋ ትመለከተዋለች። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የክልሉን ውጥረት እና ኢራን በአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ መገኘት ላይ ያላትን ተቃውሞ የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Iraan dhiheenya kana buufata xiyyaraa Muwaffaq Salti kan Al-Azraq, Yordaanositti argamu irratti haleellaa cimaa gaggeessaa jirti. Tehraan buufatni kun giddugala waraana Ameerikaa waan ta'eef, akka kaayyoo haleellaa isaatti ilaalatti. Haleellaan kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, Iraan hirmaannaa waraana Ameerikaa naannichaa mormuuf yaalii gochaa jirtuudha.

title: Trump vows to be at centre of US midterms: Republican convention takeaways
english: President Donald Trump took center stage at a unique Republican midterm convention, urging voters to treat him as if he were on the ballot despite his name not being up for election. He pledged to personally campaign across the country to help Republicans retain control of Congress, even as some party members worry his active involvement could alienate voters. The strategy aims to overcome historical trends where sitting presidents often see their party struggle in midterm contests.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በተካሄደው ልዩ የሪፐብሊካን መካከለኛ ምርጫ ጉባኤ ላይ ዋናውን ሚና በመውሰድ፣ ስማቸው በምርጫ ካርድ ላይ ባይኖርም መራጮች እሳቸው እንዳሉ እንዲቆጥሩ ጠይቀዋል። የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ በኮንግረስ ያለውን የበላይነት እንዲጠብቅ ለማድረግ በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ በንቃት እንደሚንቀሳቀሱ ቃል ገብተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ አንዳንድ የፓርቲው አባላት የእሳቸው ጣልቃ ገብነት ተቃዋሚዎችን በማነሳሳት ምርጫውን ሊጎዳ ይችላል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp yaa'ii addaa koraa giddu-galeessa waggaa (midterm) Rippabilikaanotaa irratti hirmaachuun, maqaan isaanii kan hin jirre ta'us akka waan isaan filannoo irratti dorgomaa jiranitti akka ilaalaman gaafataniiru. Rippabilikaanonnii to'annoo Kongiresii akka hin dhabneef biyyattii keessa naanna'uun duuluuf waadaa galaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, hirmaannaan isaanii kun warra ka biroo kan mufachiisuu danda'u ta'uu isaa hoggantoonni tokko tokko ni yaaddahu.

title: Thousands protest in Ljubljana as Slovenia opens Israel’s first embassy
english: Thousands of protesters gathered in Ljubljana to oppose the opening of Israel's first embassy in Slovenia. The demonstration highlights a deep divide, as Prime Minister Janez Jansa faces an impeachment bid for shifting the country's foreign policy to support Israel despite strong public opposition. This move marks a significant reversal from the previous administration, which had recognized a Palestinian state and imposed strict measures against Israel.
amharic: በስሎቬኒያ የኢትዮጵያ የመጀመሪያው የእስራኤል ኤምባሲ መከፈትን በመቃወም በሉብሊያና ከተማ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰልፈኞች ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ያኔዝ ያንሳ የእስራኤልን ግንኙነት በማጠናከራቸው በሕዝብ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ የገጠማቸው ሲሆን፣ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎችም በጉዳዩ ላይ የክስ ሂደት መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የፍልስጤምን መንግሥት እውቅና ከሰጠው እና በእስራኤል ላይ ማዕቀብ ከጣለው የቀድሞ መንግሥት አቋም ጋር የሚቃረን ነው።
oromo: Slovaniyaa keessatti ambaasaaddarri Israa'el jalqabaaf banamuun isaa mormii cimaa uumee jira. Namoonni kumaan lakkaawwaman magaalaa Luubiliyaanaa keessatti hiriiruun, murtii ministirri muummee Yaneez Yaansaa hariiroo Israa'el wajjin cimsuuf fudhataniin mormii isaanii ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan duraanii biyyattii mootummaa Filisxeem beekamtii kennuufi Israa'el irratti qabxii cimaa fudhachaa turee wajjin kan faallessu waan ta'eef, paartiileen mormituu ministiricha irratti himata akka banan godheera.

title: US announces $45m in security funding, additional naval vessels for Ecuador
english: The United States has pledged $45 million in security aid and additional naval vessels to Ecuador to support its efforts against drug trafficking and organized crime. During a visit to Quito, Secretary of State Marco Rubio praised President Daniel Noboa's administration for its aggressive stance against criminal networks. The U.S. also announced a separate $10 million initiative to combat illegal gold mining and designated the local gang 'Los Tiguerones' as a foreign terrorist organization.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአንኳኳርና በአደንዛዥ እፅ ንግድ ላይ እያደረገ ያለውን ተጋድሎ ለመደገፍ ለኢኳዶር የ45 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የፀጥታ ድጋፍ እና ተጨማሪ የባህር ኃይል መርከቦችን እንደምትሰጥ አስታውቃለች። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በኪቶ ጉብኝት ባደረጉበት ወቅት፣ የፕሬዝዳንት ዳንኤል ኖቦአ አስተዳደር የወንጀል ድርጊቶችን በመዋጋት ረገድ እያሳየ ያለውን ቁርጠኝነት አድንቀዋል። በተጨማሪም አሜሪካ ህገ-ወጥ የወርቅ ማውጣትን ለመከላከል 10 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ለመመደብ ማቀዷን እና 'ሎስ ቲጌሮነስ' የተባለውን ቡድን የውጭ አሸባሪ ድርጅት ብላ ሰይማዋለች።
oromo: Ameerikaan, biyyattii Ekuwaador keessatti daldala qoricha sammua namaa hadoochuufi yakka gurmaa'e ittisuuf deeggarsa nageenyaa doolaara miliyoona 45 fi dooniiwwan waraana galaanaa dabalataa kennuuf waadaa galteetti. Ministeerri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo, magaalaa Kiitoo yeroo daawwatanitti, mootummaan Pirezidaant Daaniyieel Nooboo yakka ittisuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachaa jiru qaban dinqisiifataniiru. Kana malees, Ameerikaan qonna warqee seeraan alaa ittisuuf doolaara miliyoona 10 kan ramadde yoo ta'u, garee yakkaa 'Loos Tiigeroones' jedhamus akka dhaabbata shororkeessaa biyya alaa tokkotti moggaasteetti.

title: Trump says the US-Iran war will end right after midterms
english: President Donald Trump has announced that the ongoing military conflict between the United States and Iran is expected to conclude shortly after the upcoming midterm elections. Although the administration previously described the engagement as a brief operation, the war has now been active for seven months. Trump had originally suggested the fighting would only last about a month.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ወታደራዊ ግጭት በመካከለኛው ዘመን ምርጫ ማግስት እንደሚቆም አስታውቀዋል። አስተዳደሩ ቀደም ሲል ግጭቱን የአጭር ጊዜ ዘመቻ ቢልም፣ ጦርነቱ ከተጀመረ ሰባት ወራት አልፈዋል። ትራምፕ በወቅቱ ግጭቱ ከአራት እስከ አምስት ሳምንታት ብቻ እንደሚቆይ ገልጸው ነበር።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp waraanni amma biyyoota Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti adeemaa jiru filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa booda hatattamaan akka xumuramu ibsaniiru. Mootummaan isaanii yeroo duraa waraana kana akka duula gabaabaatti ibsanii kan turan ta'us, amma ji'a torba guuteera. Traamp jalqaba irratti waraanni kun torban afur ykn shan qofa akka fudhatu dubbatanii turan.

title: Iran war looms over Trump at Republican midterm convention in Dallas
english: President Donald Trump is centering his political campaign around the Republican midterm convention in Dallas, despite growing public concerns over his ongoing war with Iran. Rising oil prices and economic uncertainty have left many voters questioning how this conflict aligns with Trump’s 'America First' policy. While the President’s core supporters remain loyal, some attendees expressed confusion about the necessity of the war and its impact on the daily lives of American families.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ የከፈቱት ጦርነት እየፈጠረ ባለው የኢኮኖሚ ጫና እና በነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ መካከል በዳላስ በተካሄደው የሪፐብሊካን ኮንቬንሽን ላይ በዋናነት ተሳትፈዋል። ብዙ መራጮች ይህ ጦርነት በትራምፕ የ'አሜሪካ ቀዳሚ' መፈክር ጋር እንዴት እንደሚጣጣም ጥያቄ እያነሱ ይገኛሉ። የትራምፕ ደጋፊዎች በሙሉ ልባቸው ቢደግፉትም፣ አንዳንዶች ግን የጦርነቱን አስፈላጊነት እና በአሜሪካ ቤተሰቦች ላይ እያደረሰ ያለውን ተጽዕኖ በመጠራጠር ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp waraana Iraan irratti bananiin hordofee gatiin boba'aa dabaluu fi rakkoon diinagdee mudachuu isaatiin walqabatee, konveenshinii dhaabbata Rippaabilikaanii Daalaasitti gaggeeffame irratti xiyyeeffannoon kennameefii jira. Namoonni hedduun waraanni kun imaammata Tiraamp kan 'Ameerikaan dursiti' jedhu waliin walitti dhufeenya akkamii akka qabu gaaffii kaasaniiru. Hordoftoonni Tiraamp amanamoo ta'anis, namoonni tokko tokko garuu waraanni kun barbaachisaa ta'uu isaa fi jireenya maatiiwwan Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa inni geessisu irratti shakkiin isaanitti dhaga'ameera.

title: Gauff beats Andreeva to reach US Open semifinals in comeback win
english: American tennis star Coco Gauff staged an impressive comeback against Mirra Andreeva to secure her spot in the US Open semifinals. After losing the first set and facing two match points, Gauff regained her composure and momentum to win the next two sets. She is now scheduled to play against Elena Rybakina in the next round of the tournament.
amharic: የአሜሪካዋ የቴኒስ ኮከብ ኮኮ ጎፍ ሚራ አንድሬቫን በመርታት ወደ ዩኤስ ኦፕን ግማሽ ፍፃሜ ማለፏን አረጋግጣለች። የመጀመሪያውን ዙር በሽንፈት የጀመረችው ጎፍ፣ ሁለት የጨዋታ ነጥቦች ተይዞባት የነበረ ቢሆንም በአስደናቂ ሁኔታ ተመልሳ ቀጣዮቹን ሁለት ዙሮች በማሸነፍ ለግማሽ ፍፃሜው በቅታለች። አሁን በግማሽ ፍፃሜው ከኤሌና ሪባኪና ጋር ትፋለማለች።
oromo: Taphattuun teniisii Ameerikaa Kookoo Gaaf, Mirraa Andrevaarratti injifannoo ajaa'ibaa galmeessuun gara hamma xumuraa dorgommii US Open dabarteetti. Setii jalqabaa erga dhabdee fi carraa shan irratti irra deddeebi'ee mudatee booda, Gaaf of-to'achuun setiiwwan itti aanan lamaan moo'attee gara sadarkaa itti aanutti darbiteetti. Amma hamma xumuraa keessatti Elena Riybaakiinaa wajjin kan wal-morkattu ta'a.

title: ‘Everyone’s had their holidays ruined’: outrage after UK airport chaos
english: Thousands of travelers faced significant disruptions after a major air traffic control system failure led to widespread flight cancellations across the UK. In response to the growing public anger over ruined travel plans, the British transport minister has ordered an independent investigation into the incident. The review aims to determine the root cause of the technical outage and prevent future occurrences.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የአየር ትራፊክ ቁጥጥር ስርዓት ባጋጠመው ከፍተኛ ብልሽት ሳቢያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎች በመሰረዛቸው ተጓዦች ከፍተኛ ችግር ገጥሟቸዋል። በጉዳዩ የተበሳጩ ተጓዦችን ስሜት ለመጋራት እና መፍትሄ ለመስጠት፣ የብሪታንያ የትራንስፖርት ሚኒስትር በችግሩ ላይ ገለልተኛ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ትእዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ምርመራ የቴክኒክ ብልሽቱን ትክክለኛ ምክንያት ለይቶ በማውጣት ወደፊት መሰል ችግሮች እንዳይከሰቱ ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: UK keessatti sirni to’annoo tiraafika qilleensaa tasa addaan cituun isaa balallii kumaatamaan lakkaa’aman akka haqaman taasiseera. Rakkoo fi miidhaa kana hordofee, ministeerri geejjibaa biyyattii sababa balaa kanaa qorachuuf qaama walaba ta’e tokko ajajeera. Qorannoon kun rakkoon teknikaa sun akkamiin akka uumame adda baasee, gara fuulduraatti balallii qilleensaa irratti rakkoo akkasii hambisuuf kan gargaaru ta’a.

title: UN chief warns of ‘grave consequences’ from Hormuz escalation
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has called for urgent de-escalation in the Strait of Hormuz following reports of attacks on commercial ships and threats to energy infrastructure. He emphasized that international law must protect maritime freedom and urged all involved parties to resolve their conflicts through diplomatic dialogue. The UN is also actively working to facilitate a plan for the safe transport of vital grain supplies through the region.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ጸሐፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ እየደረሰ ባለው ጥቃት እና በሃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ላይ ባለው ስጋት የተነሳ ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እንዲደረግ አሳስበዋል። በባህር ላይ የመዘዋወር መብት በዓለም አቀፍ ህግ መከበር እንዳለበት የገለጹት ዋና ጸሐፊው፣ ግጭቶችን በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የእህል አቅርቦቶችን በአካባቢው በኩል በሰላም ለማጓጓዝ እየሰራ መሆኑንም አስታውቋል።
oromo: Hogganaan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomani Antooniyoo Guterreez, naannoo harka dhibbaa Hormuzitti haleellaan markaboota daldalaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru balaa guddaa waan qabuuf akka tasgabbaa'an waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Mirgi birmadummaa galaana keessaa seera idil-addunyaatiin kabajamuun akka qabu eeruun, gareewwan hundi mariidhaan gara furmaataatti akka dhufan gaafataniiru. Dhaabbatichi dhiyeessii midhaan nyaataa barbaachisaa ta'e naannoo sanaan tasgabbiin akka darbuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira.

title: Hamas member released in exchange for Israeli soldier Gilad Shalit killed in Gaza
english: Farah Hamed, a high-ranking Hamas military commander, was killed during an Israeli airstrike in Gaza on Wednesday. Hamed was originally from the West Bank but had been living in Gaza after being released from prison in 2011 as part of a major captive swap deal. Reports indicate that he died following a shelling incident near Gaza City.
amharic: የሃማስ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ አዛዥ የሆኑት ፋራህ ሃመድ በእስራኤል የአየር ድብደባ በጋዛ ተገድለዋል። ሃመድ በ2011 እስረኞች የመለዋወጥ ስምምነት መሰረት ከእስር ከተለቀቁ በኋላ በጋዛ ይኖሩ የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ መጀመሪያ የመጡት ከዌስት ባንክ ነው። ዘገባዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት፣ እኚህ አዛዥ በጋዛ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የቦምብ ጥቃት ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa olaanaa garee Hamaas kan ta'an Farah Haamed, kibxata darbe weerara xiyyaaraa Israa'el Itoophiyaa gahuun gazaatti ajjeefamaniiru. Haamed bara 2011 wal jijjiirraa hidhamtootaatiin gadhiifamanii gazaatti kan qubatan turan. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, ajajaan kun magaalaa Gaza biratti miidhama boombii irra gaheen lubbuun isaanii darbeera.

title: Protest held in Slovenian capital against opening of Israeli embassy
english: Pro-Palestinian demonstrators gathered in Ljubljana to oppose the establishment of Israel's first embassy in Slovenia. The embassy's opening marks a shift in diplomatic relations under Prime Minister Janez Jansa's administration. Israel’s foreign minister traveled to the country to officially inaugurate the new diplomatic mission.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ደጋፊዎች በእስራኤል እና በስሎቬኒያ መካከል ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የተከፈተውን ኤምባሲ በመቃወም በሉብሊያና ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። ይህ የኤምባሲ መከፈት በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጃኔዝ ያንሳ አስተዳደር ስር ያለውን አዲሱን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ያሳያል። የእስራኤል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አዲሱን ኤምባሲ በይፋ ለመክፈት ወደ ስሎቬኒያ ተጉዘዋል።
oromo: Deeggartoonni Falasxiin, biyyi Israa'el jalqabaaf Sloveniyaa keessatti ambaasaaddara ishee banuu ishee mormuuf magaala Luubliyaanaa keessatti hiriira bahan. Banamuun ambaasaaddara kanaa mootummaa Ministira Mummee Jaaneez Yaansaa jalatti hariiroo dippiloomaasii haaraa jalqabame kan agarsiisuudha. Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Israa'el ambaasaaddarichaa bakkatti banuuf gara Sloveniyaa imaleera.

title: Iran's Baghaei says Houthis are independent actors, not proxies of Iran
english: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei has rejected claims by U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio that the Houthi movement acts as a proxy for Iran. Baghaei stated that the Houthis make their own independent decisions and are not influenced by Tehran. Furthermore, he argued that U.S. military involvement and interference are the primary causes of regional instability.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ እስማኤል ባጋኢ፣ የየመኑ የሁቲ አማፂያን የኢራን ተወካዮች ናቸው በሚል የአሜሪካው ውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ያቀረቡትን ክስ አስተባብለዋል። ባጋኢ እንደገለጹት ሁቲዎች የራሳቸውን ውሳኔ በራሳቸው የሚወስኑ ገለልተኛ ቡድን ናቸው። በተጨማሪም በክልሉ ለሚፈጠረው አለመረጋጋት ዋና ምክንያት የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣልቃ ገብነት እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iraan Isma’el Baqa’ii, himata ministirri dhimma alaa Amerikaa Maarkoo Rubiyoon gareen Huutii kan Iraaniin to’atamu ta’uu isaa dhiheesseef mormaniru. Baqa’iin akka jedhetti, gareen Huutii of danda’ee kan murteessuufi ajaja eenyuu iyyuu kan hin fudhanne dha. Kana malees, rakkoon nageenyaa naannichaa inni guddaan giddu-galeessa Amerikaa fi fedhii dhiibbaa ishee irraa kan madde ta’uu ibsaniiru.

title: Iranian media: ‘several areas’ in Sirik hit by projectiles
english: Iranian state media reported that multiple locations in the city of Sirik were struck by projectiles launched by an adversary. These attacks occurred shortly after residents and news outlets noted hearing loud explosions in the regions of Qeshm Island and Minab. The situation remains developing as authorities investigate the reported strikes.
amharic: የኢራን የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙኃን በሲሪክ ከተማ ውስጥ በሚገኙ በርካታ አካባቢዎች ላይ በጠላት የተተኮሱ ሚሳኤሎች ማረፋቸውን ዘግበዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የደረሱት በኬሽም ደሴት እና በሚናብ ካውንቲ አካባቢ ከፍተኛ የፍንዳታ ድምፆች ከተሰሙ በኋላ ነው። ባለስልጣናት በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Miidiyaaleen mootummaa Iraan akka gabaasanitti, magaalota Sirik keessatti bakkeewwan hedduu irratti xiyyoon diinotaan dhukaafaman rukutamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame erga guyyoota muraasa dura naannoo qeeshm fi Miinaabitti sagaleen dhohiinsa guddaa dhaga'amee booda. Aangeyyoonni mootummaa haala kana ilaalchisee qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
english: Newly released documents reveal that Spanish intelligence warned officials about potential mass migrant crossings into Ceuta just one day before they occurred. Although the Prime Minister claimed the event was unpredictable, intelligence reports show they had monitored social media plans involving thousands of people. Over 70,000 migrants crossed the border, leading to a humanitarian crisis and ongoing unrest in the Spanish territory.
amharic: አዲስ ይፋ የተደረጉ ሰነዶች እንደሚያሳዩት የስፔን የደህንነት ተቋማት ወደ ሴውታ በብዛት የሚገቡ ስደተኞችን አስመልክቶ አስቀድመው ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተው ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ክስተቱን መገመት አይቻልም ብለው ቢከራከሩም፣ የደህንነት መረጃዎች በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የሚያደርጉትን እንቅስቃሴ አስቀድመው ይከታተሉ እንደነበር ያሳያሉ። በዚህም የተነሳ ከ70,000 በላይ ስደተኞች ድንበሩን በማቋረጣቸው በስፔን ግዛት ውስጥ ሰብአዊ ቀውስ እና አለመረጋጋት ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Sanado haaraa ifa ta'an akka agarsiisanitti, tajaajilli odeeffannoo Ispeen namoonni hedduun gara magaalatti Ceuta akka seenan guyyaa tokko dura akeekkachiise ture. Ministirri Muummee kun raaguun kan hin danda'amne akka ta'e dubbatanis, ragaan qabame garuu qophiin miidiyaa hawaasummaa namoota kumaatamaan lakka'aman hirmaachise akka jira ture mirkaneessa. Namoonni kuma 70 ol ta'an daangaa kana ce'uun isaanii, naannoo Ispeen kana keessatti rakkoo namoomaa fi jeequmsa hordofsiiseera.

title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
english: The International Atomic Energy Agency has referred Iran to the UN Security Council for the first time in two decades due to its failure to cooperate with nuclear inspections. The resolution, backed by several Western nations, criticizes Iran for hiding information about its uranium stockpiles and restricting inspector access. While Tehran claims recent military strikes by the US and Israel justify these restrictions, international concern remains regarding Iran's potential development of nuclear weapons.
amharic: የአለም አቀፉ አቶሚክ ኢነርጂ ኤጀንሲ (IAEA) ኢራን የኑክሌር ቁጥጥር ስምምነቶችን ባለማክበሯ ጉዳዩን ለተባበሩት መንግስታት የፀጥታው ምክር ቤት መርቷል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ኢራን የዩራኒየም ክምችቷን በተመለከተ መረጃ ባለመስጠቷ እና ተቆጣጣሪዎች ወደ ተቋማቷ እንዳይገቡ በመከልከሏ ነው። ኢራን በበኩሏ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል ጥቃት ምክንያት ምርመራዎችን ማካሄድ እንዳልቻለች በመግለጽ ውሳኔውን ተቃውማለች።
oromo: Ejensiin anniisaa niwukileraa addunyaa, Iran walii galtee niwukileraa kabajuu dhabuu isheetin kan ka'e dhimma ishee gara mana maree nageenyaa UN tti ergeera. Murteen kun kan darbe Iran kuusaa yuranium ishee irratti odeeffannoo kennuu diduu fi to'attoota gara buufata ishee akka hin seenne dhorkuu isheetin walqabatee dha. Iran gama isheetin, haleellaa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el ishee irratti raawwataniin to'annoon akka hin gaggeeffamne ibsuun murtee kana balaaleffatteetti.

title: US court denies Tate brothers’ bid to be released from Miami jail
english: A U.S. judge has rejected Andrew and Tristan Tate's request for release from a Miami jail while they fight extradition to the U.K. to face rape and trafficking charges. The court determined the brothers are a high flight risk due to their global travel history and financial resources. Despite their legal team's claims that their online persona is exaggerated, the judge ruled that they must remain in custody during the legal process.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ፍርድ ቤት አንዲው እና ትሪስታን ቴይት ወደ እንግሊዝ እንዳይላኩ በሚያደርጉት ክርክር ወቅት ከማያሚ እስር ቤት በዋስትና እንዲፈቱ የቀረበውን ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርጓል። ዳኛው ወንድማማቾቹ ብዙ ዓለም አቀፍ ጉዞዎችን የሚያደርጉ እና ከፍተኛ ሀብት ያላቸው በመሆኑ፣ ከሀገር የመሸሽ ከፍተኛ ዕድል እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል። ጠበቃዎቻቸው በኢንተርኔት የሚያሳዩት የቅንጦት ሕይወት የተጋነነ መሆኑን ቢገልጹም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ በእስር እንዲቆዩ ወስኗል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa Yunaayitid Isteetes, obboloonni Endiruu fi Tiristaan Teetiin himannaa gudeeddii fi nama daldaluun walqabatee gara biyya Ingilizitti akka ergamanitti mormaa jiran, hidhaa Maayamiirraa akka gadi lakkifaman gaaffii dhiyeessan dhabeera. Mana murichatti, obboloonni kun imala biyyoota addunyaa irra deddeebi'anii gochuun isaanii fi qabeenya qaban sababeeffachuun akka biyyaa baqatanii baduu danda'an yaadameera. Gareen abukaattoota isaanii jireenyi isaanii inni miidiyaarratti mul'atu kan daawwitii qofa akka ta'e dubbatanis, murtiin mana murichaa hanga dhimmi isaanii xumuramutti hidhaatti akka turan ajajeera.

title: Misfiring Arsenal beat Napoli with Odegaard stunner in Champions League
english: Arsenal secured a narrow 1-0 victory over Napoli in their opening Champions League match thanks to a powerful strike from captain Martin Odegaard. Despite creating multiple scoring opportunities throughout the game, the English side struggled to convert their chances against a disciplined defensive setup. This win marks a successful start to their European campaign while maintaining their strong early-season form.
amharic: አርሰናል በቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ መክፈቻ ጨዋታው በካፒቴኑ ማርቲን ኦዴጋርድ ብቸኛ ግብ ናፖሊን 1 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ ጉዞውን በድል ጀምሯል። አርሰናል በጨዋታው በርካታ የግብ ማግባት አጋጣሚዎችን ቢፈጥርም፣ ጠንካራ የናፖሊ የተከላካይ ክፍልን ለመስበር ተቸግሮ ነበር። ይህ ድል አርሰናል በአውሮፓ መድረክ ጠንካራ አጀማመር እንዲያደርግ ያስቻለው ሲሆን፣ የውድድር ዘመኑን ጥሩ አጀማመርም ያሳያል።
oromo: Arsenal taphachuu Champions League irratti qabxii tokkoo fi duwwaa (1-0) gola kabtiinii isaanii Martin Odegaard galcheen Napoli injifachuu danda'eera. Arsenal carraa hedduu uumus, ittisa Napoli kan cimaa ture cabsuuf baay'ee rakkatee ture. Injifannoon kun Arsenal tapha Awurooppaa irratti jalqaba gaarii akka godhu kan isa gargaare yoo ta'u, qophii fi ga'umsa isaanii kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Manchester United vs Sabah: UEFA Champions League – preview, team news
english: Manchester United is preparing to return to the UEFA Champions League for the first time in three years, facing Azerbaijan's Sabah at Old Trafford this Thursday. Although the team has had a slow start in the Premier League, manager Michael Carrick remains confident in the squad's ability to compete at the highest level. Carrick emphasized that the team is focused on achieving significant results in the competition rather than just participating.

oromo: Maanchistar Yuunaytid waggaa sadii booda yeroo jalqabaaf gara dorgommii Chaampiyoons Liigii deebi'uuf qophii xumuree, Dilbata kana Old Trafford irratti garee Chaampiyoonii Azarbaijan Sabah waliin wal morkata. Gareen kun Liigii Ingilizii keessatti jalqaba gaarii hin goone ta'us, leenjisaan Maayikil Kaarik dargaggoonni isaa sadarkaa olaanaatti morkachuu akka danda'an abdii guddaa qaba. Kaarik, gareen isaa dorgommicharratti hirmaachuu qofa osoo hin taane, bu'aa ajaa'ibsiisaa galmeessuuf akka kaayyeffate ibseera.

title: Liverpool come back to beat Atletico Madrid 2-1 in Champions League opener
english: Liverpool secured a 2-1 victory over Atletico Madrid in their Champions League opener after rallying from an early deficit. Marcos Llorente initially put the visitors ahead, but Dominik Szoboszlai equalized before Alexis Mac Allister scored the winning goal. Despite the win, Liverpool suffered a setback as new player Bradley Barcola left the game with a calf injury.
amharic: ሊቨርፑል በሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ መክፈቻ ጨዋታ አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድን 2-1 በማሸነፍ አስደናቂ ድል አስመዝግቧል። ምንም እንኳን ማርኮስ ዮሬንቴ አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድን ቀዳሚ ቢያደርግም፣ ዶሚኒክ ሶቦስላይ አቻ መለያ ግብ አስቆጥሮ አሌክሲስ ማክ አሊስተር የድል ግቧን በማስገባት ሊቨርፑልን አሸናፊ አድርጓል። ሆኖም አዲሱ ፈራሚ ብራድሊ ባርኮላ በጉዳት ምክንያት ሜዳውን ለቆ መውጣቱ ለሊቨርፑል መጥፎ ዜና ሆኗል።
oromo: Liiverpuul tapha banisaa Chaampiyoons Liigii irratti Atleetikoo Maadriid 2-1 injifateera. Taphatichi utuu hin jalqabin Atleetikoon goolii dursite argattus, Liiverpuul gadi bu'ee taphachuun Doomiinik Soboslaayii fi Aleksiis Maak Aaliistar gooliiwwan injifannoo argamsiisan galchaniiru. Injifannoo kana keessatti, taphataan haaraan Liiverpuul Biraadlii Baarkoolaa miidhama maashaatiin taphicha keessaa bahuun gadda garee sanaa ta'eera.

title: Trump says Iran war ‘will end immediately’ after US midterm elections
english: President Donald Trump announced that the ongoing war with Iran will conclude immediately following the upcoming United States midterm elections. He alleged that Iran is intentionally delaying a resolution to influence the election results in hopes of securing a more favorable political outcome. Trump emphasized that the conflict remains centered on concerns regarding Iran's nuclear program and regional security.

oromo: Pireezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp waraanni Iraan waliin taasifamaa jiru filannoo giddu-galeessa biyyattii booda battalumatti akka dhaabbatu ibsaniiru. Iraan bu'aa filannichaa jijjiiruuf jecha waraanicha akka dheeressaa jirtu fi mootummaa biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf akka yaaltu himataniiru. Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, waraanni kun kan xiyyeeffate sagantaa niwukilaraa Iraan fi nageenya naannichaa irratti ta'uu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: Explosions heard in Iran's Minab, Sirik, Qeshm Island
english: Local reports indicate that loud explosive sounds were heard across several areas in Iran’s Hormozgan province, including Qeshm Island, Sirik, and Minab. While the exact source of the noise remains under investigation, regional authorities have suggested the sounds originated from the sea. There is currently no official confirmation regarding the specific cause or nature of these incidents.

oromo: Godina Hoormozgaan kan Iraan keessatti argaman magaalaan Sirik, Minab fi odoolli Qeshm sagalee dhukaatii cimaa akka dhaga'an gabaafameera. Sababni sagalee kanaa hanga ammaa ifa kan hin taane yoo ta'u, qondaaltoonni naannichaa sagaleen kun gararraa kan dhufe ta'uu akka malan ibsaniiru. Dhimmicha irratti hanga ammaatti ibsiifamaa ta'e tokkollee hin kennamne.

title: Records reveal Cuny investments in weapons firms supplying Israel
english: Financial documents have revealed that the City University of New York (CUNY) holds over $715,000 in investments across major weapons manufacturers that supply the Israeli military. Pro-Palestinian activist groups obtained these records, arguing that the university is complicit in the ongoing conflict in Gaza. This disclosure follows a long-term student and faculty campaign demanding transparency and divestment from defense contractors.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ከተማ ዩኒቨርሲቲ (CUNY) ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል የጦር መሳሪያ የሚያቀርቡ ኩባንያዎች ላይ ከ715,000 ዶላር በላይ ኢንቨስት ማድረጉ በወጡ የፋይናንስ ሰነዶች ተረጋግጧል። ፍልስጤምን የሚደግፉ ቡድኖች እነዚህን መረጃዎች ያገኙ ሲሆን፣ ዩኒቨርሲቲው በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት ተባባሪ ነው ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። ይህ ይፋ መውጣት የተማሪዎች እና መምህራን ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲያደርጉት የቆዩት ተቋሙ ከጦር መሳሪያ አምራቾች ጋር ያለውን የፋይናንስ ግንኙነት እንዲያቋርጥ የጠየቁት ጥረት ውጤት ነው።
oromo: Yuunivarsiitiin magaalaa Niiwu Yoorkii (CUNY) dhaabbata waraanaaf meeshaa gurguru kanneen waraana Israa'el gargaaran irratti doolaara 715,000 ol akka innavastii godhe ragaan faayinaansii ni mirkaneessa. Gareewwan deggertoota Palastinaa ragaa kana argachuun, yuunivarsiitiin kun waraana Gaaza keessatti adeemaa jiru keessatti hirmaataa fi gargaaraa dha jechuun himatu. Ifa ta'uun ragaa kanaa, barattoonni fi barsiisonni yeroo dheeraaf yuunivarsiitiin kun dhaabbilee meeshaa waraanaa oomishan waliin hidhata akka hin qabaanne gaafachaa turan kan mul'isu dha.

title: Two Palestinians injured in Israeli military raid south of Nablus
english: Two young Palestinian men were injured during an Israeli military operation in the town of Awarta, located south of Nablus. Soldiers used live fire, tear gas, and stun grenades while raiding the area. The victims, both 24 years old, required hospital care after being physically assaulted by the forces.
amharic: በናብለስ በስተደቡብ በምትገኘው አዋርታ በተባለች ከተማ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ባደረጉት ወረራ ሁለት የፍልስጤም ወጣቶች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ወታደሮቹ በከተማዋ ወረራ ሲፈጽሙ ጥይቶችን፣ እንባ አውሬ ጋዝ እና ድምፅ አልባ ቦምቦችን ተጠቅመዋል። የ24 ዓመት ዕድሜ ያላቸው ሁለቱ ወጣቶች በወታደሮቹ ድብደባ ስለደረሰባቸው ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Magaalaa Nablus kibbatti argamtu Awarta jedhamtutti duula waraana Israa'el gaggeesseen dargaggoonni Falasxiin lama miidhaniiru. Waraanni Israa'el magaalamtitti yeroo seenu dhukaasa rasaasaa, gaazii imimmaaniifi meeshaalee humna guddaa qaban fayyadamaniiru. Dargaggoonni umriin isaanii waggaa 24 ta'an kunneen waraana kanaan reebichis erga irra ga'ee booda yaalamuf gara hospitaalaatti geeffamaniiru.

title: Israeli strikes hit three more areas in southern Lebanon
english: On Wednesday, the Israeli military conducted aerial bombardments across three distinct locations in southern Lebanon. The targeted areas include the villages of Nabatieh al-Fawqa and al-Mansouri, as well as the region surrounding Wadi al-Saluqi. These strikes represent a continuation of the ongoing military activity in the border zone.
amharic: ረቡዕ ዕለት የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ ሶስት የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ጥቃቶቹ ናባቲህ አል-ፈውቃ እና አል-ማንሱሪ የተባሉ መንደሮችን እንዲሁም ዋዲ አል-ሳሉቂን ያካተቱ ናቸው። እነዚህ ድብደባዎች በአካባቢው እየተካሄደ ያለውን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Guyyaa Roobii darbe kana, waraanni Israaʼel kibba Libaanoos keessatti bakkeewwan sadii irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraan raawwateera. Haleellaan kun baadiyaalee Naabaatiyaa al-Fawqaa fi al-Mansuurii akkasumas naannoo Waadii al-Saaluuqii kan ilaallatuudha. Gochi kun walitti bu’iinsa naannichatti itti fufee jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Rubio vows to ‘strangle’ Iran economically
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced that the United States will keep targeting Iranian oil tankers in response to attacks on American warships. He stated that the US is committed to pressuring Tehran by severely limiting its economy. Rubio emphasized that Iran will continue to face financial consequences for its aggressive actions against US naval vessels.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በሀገራቸው የባህር ኃይል መርከቦች ላይ ለሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች ምላሽ ለመስጠት የአሜሪካ መንግስት የኢራን የነዳጅ መርከቦችን ማነጣጠሩን እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል። ዋሽንግተን የኢራንን ኢኮኖሚ በማዳከም ከፍተኛ ጫና ለመፍጠር እየሰራች መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በዚሁ መሰረት ኢራን በአሜሪካ መርከቦች ላይ ለምታደርገው ጥቃት የኢኮኖሚ ዋጋ መክፈሏን እንደምትቀጥል አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo, Ameerikaan dooniiwwan waraanaa ishee irratti haleellaa raawwatamuuf deebii kennuuf jecha dooniiwwan boba'aa Iraan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka itti fufu ibsaniiru. Waashingitan diinagdee Iraan laaffisuun dhiibbaa cimaa uumuu akka barbaaddu ibsaniiru. Haaluma kanaan, Iraan dooniiwwan waraanaa Ameerikaa irratti gocha diinummaa raawwattuuf gatii diinagdee kaffaluun ishee kan itti fufu ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: Israeli strike targets home in Gaza’s al-Shati refugee camp
english: An Israeli airstrike has destroyed a residential house located in the al-Shati refugee camp in Gaza City, causing significant damage to nearby properties. Prior to the attack, Israeli forces had issued evacuation orders for a school, a health facility, and a residential building in the area. Local reporters have confirmed the extensive destruction caused by the strike on the camp.
amharic: የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኘው አል-ሻቲ የስደተኞች መጠለያ ካምፕ ውስጥ የሚገኝ መኖሪያ ቤት ሙሉ በሙሉ አውድሟል፤ በዙሪያው የነበሩ ቤቶችም ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጥቃቱ ከመፈጸሙ በፊት እስራኤል በአካባቢው በሚገኙ ትምህርት ቤት፣ የጤና ጣቢያ እና የመኖሪያ ሕንፃ ላይ የመልቀቂያ ትእዛዝ ሰጥታ ነበር። ጋዜጠኞች በቦታው ተገኝተው የደረሰውን ከፍተኛ ውድመት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el qubata baqattootaa al-Shati kan magaala Gaza keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraan raawwateen mana jireenyaa tokko kan diigame yoo ta'u, mannoota naannawa sana jiranis miidheen guddaan irra ga'eera. Haleellaa kana dura, Israa'el manneen barnootaa, buufata fayyaa fi mana jireenyaa tokko irraa akka namoonni gadi ba'an ajajtee turte. Gabaastonni naannichaa haleellaan sun miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Two rescued after plane makes emergency landing in Black Sea
english: Two Belgian citizens were safely rescued by Turkish authorities after their private plane experienced engine trouble over the Black Sea. The individuals, aged 55 and 69, were forced to perform an emergency landing in the water. Both survivors are reported to be in good health following the incident.
amharic: ሁለት ቤልጂየማውያን በግል አውሮፕላናቸው ላይ ያጋጠመውን የሞተር ብልሽት ተከትሎ በጥቁር ባህር ላይ አስቸኳይ ማረፊያ ካደረጉ በኋላ በቱርክ ባለስልጣናት ታድገዋል። የ55 እና የ69 ዓመት ዕድሜ ያላቸው እነዚህ ግለሰቦች ከስኬታማው የነፍስ አድን ስራ በኋላ የጤንነት ሁኔታቸው ጥሩ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Lammiileen Beeljiyam lama xiyyaara dhuunfaa isaanii irratti rakkoo injinii erga mudatee booda, Galaana Gurraacha irra buufachuu dirqamaniiru. Namoonni umriin isaanii 55 fi 69 ta'an kun hojii fayyinsaa abbootii taayitaa Turkiitiin lubbuun isaanii ooleera. Namoonni kunneen yeroo ammaa fayyaa gaarii akka qaban himameera.

title: China slams US claims of ‘industrial-scale’ AI theft
english: China has rejected U.S. accusations that its artificial intelligence firms are stealing American technology on a massive scale. Three U.S. federal agencies claim Chinese companies like Alibaba and DeepSeek have been illicitly training their systems using data from U.S. models. Beijing has denied these allegations, calling the practice standard industry behavior and warning that it will take action if the U.S. continues to restrict its tech companies.
amharic: ቻይና የሀገሪቱ የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ኩባንያዎች የአሜሪካን ቴክኖሎጂ በስፋት እየሰረቁ ነው የሚለውን የአሜሪካ ክስ ውድቅ አድርጋለች። የሦስት የአሜሪካ የፌደራል ኤጀንሲዎች እንደ አሊባባ እና ዲፕሲክ ያሉ የቻይና ኩባንያዎች የአሜሪካን ሞዴሎች በመጠቀም የራሳቸውን ሲስተም እያሳደጉ ነው የሚል ክስ አቅርበዋል። ቤጂንግ ይህ ተግባር በኢንዱስትሪው ውስጥ የተለመደ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ አሜሪካ በኩባንያዎቿ ላይ የሚወስደውን ጫና የምትቀጥል ከሆነ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Chaayinaan, dhaabbileen teeknooloojii 'AI' ishee kan Ameerikaa irraa humnaan hatuudha jedhamee kan irratti dhiyaate himannaa Ameerikaa dhugaa miti jettee mormite. Ejensiileen federaalaa Ameerikaa sadii, dhaabbileen Chaayinaa akka Alibabaa fi DeepSeek odeeffannoo fi teeknooloojii Ameerikaa fayyadamuun sirnoota isaanii akka guddisan himatu. Chaayinaan gochi kun sadarkaa addunyaatti kan baramee fi idileedha jechuun, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa ishee yoo itti fufte tarkaanfii gufachiisaa akka fudhattu akeekkachiisteetti.

title: Rampant Raphinha nets two goals as Barcelona rout Feyenoord
english: Barcelona kicked off their Champions League season with a dominant 5-1 victory over Feyenoord. Raphinha led the charge with two goals, supported by impressive finishes from teammates Karim Adeyemi, Lamine Yamal, and Gabriel Jesus. The Spanish club continues its perfect form this season, having won every match they have played so far.
amharic: ባርሴሎና የዘንድሮውን የቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ውድድር ፈየኖርድን 5 ለ 1 በሆነ ሰፊ ውጤት በመርታት በድል ጀምሯል። ራፊንሃ ሁለት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር የቡድኑን ድል መሪ ሲሆን፣ ቀሪዎቹን ግቦች ካሪም አዴዬሚ፣ ላሚን ያማል እና ገብርኤል ጄሱስ አስቆጥረዋል። ባርሴሎና በዚህ የውድድር ዘመን እስካሁን ባደረጋቸው ጨዋታዎች ሁሉ ማሸነፍ በመቻሉ ጠንካራ ብቃቱን አሳይቷል።
oromo: Barseloonaan tapha waancaa Chaampiyoons Liigii isaa, garee Feyenoord irratti 5-1 qabxii guddaan injifachuun jalqabe. Raafiniiya goolii lama lakkoofsiisuun dursaa ture, hiriyoonni isaa Kaarim Adeyemii, Laamiin Yaamaal fi Gaabireel Jeesusis gooliiwwan itti aanan galchaniiru. Gareen Ispeen kun amma ammaatti taphuma godhe hunda injifachuun yeroo ammaa amala gaarii irratti argama.

title: Yemeni diplomat says Houthis want to drag Saudi Arabia into war
english: Yemen’s ambassador to Qatar, Rajeh Hussain Farhan Badi, claims that Houthi rebels are actively attempting to provoke Saudi Arabia into a larger military conflict. He states that the group is intentionally attacking Saudi infrastructure and vessels in the Red Sea to escalate regional tensions. These actions appear designed to draw the neighboring nation directly into the ongoing Yemeni war.
amharic: የየመን የኳታር አምባሳደር ራጄህ ሁሴን ፋርሃን ባዲ እንደተናገሩት፣ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ሳዑዲ አረቢያን ወደ ግጭት ለማስገባት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ቡድኑ የሳዑዲን መሠረተ ልማቶች እና በቀይ ባህር ውስጥ የሚገኙ የሳዑዲ ተያያዥ መርከቦችን በማጥቃት ቀጣናዊ ውጥረትን ለመጫር እየሞከረ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ተግባር ሳዑዲ አረቢያን በቀጥታ በየመን ጦርነት ውስጥ ለመክተት ያለመ እንደሆነ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Yaman kan Qaatar, Raajeh Huseen Farhaan Baadii, finxaaleyyiin Huutii Saudi Arabiyaa gara waraanaatti harkisuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru jedhaniiru. Gareen kun bu'uuraalee misoomaa Saudi Arabiyaa fi dooniiwwan garbaa diimaa keessatti argaman irratti haleellaa raawwachuun, walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa hammeessuuf yaalaa akka jiru ibsaniiru. Gochaan kunis Saudi Arabiyaa waraana Yaman keessatti qindoominaan hirmaachisuuf kan karoorfame fakkaata.

title: Texas curriculum change will portray Islam as 'radical' and 'brutal'
english: The Texas State Board of Education has approved a new social studies curriculum that will describe early Islam as brutal and radical while emphasizing Christianity in a positive light. Starting in the 2030-2031 school year, this policy will impact five million public school students across the state. The updated teaching materials will focus on negative aspects of Islamic history and attribute the 9/11 attacks specifically to radical religious ideology.
amharic: የቴክሳስ የትምህርት ቦርድ የእስልምናን ሃይማኖት እንደ ጨካኝ እና አክራሪ አድርጎ የሚያሳይ አዲስ የማህበራዊ ሳይንስ ስርአተ ትምህርት አጽድቋል። ይህ አዲስ መመሪያ ከ2030-2031 የትምህርት ዘመን ጀምሮ በአምስት ሚሊዮን የቴክሳስ ተማሪዎች ላይ ተጽእኖ ይኖረዋል። አዲሱ የትምህርት እቅድ ክርስትናን በጥሩ ገጽታ በማሳየት እስልምናን በባርነት እና በጦርነት ላይ ብቻ በማተኮር እንዲያስተምር ይገደዳል።
oromo: Boordiin barnoota biyyattii Teeksaas sirna barnoota haaraa kan amantii Islaamaa akka amantii hammeenyaa fi akraarummaa qabutti ibsu raggaaseera. Karoorri barnootaa kun barattoota miliyoona shaniif kan qophaa'e yoo ta'u, bara barnootaa 2030-2031 irraa jalqabee hojiirra oola. Sirni barnootaa kun kristaanaummaa sadarkaa olaanaatti kan ol kaasuufi seenaa Islaamaa immoo haala qorqonnaa fi hammeenyaa irratti xiyyeeffatee kan dhiyeessu ta'a.

title: Trump says Iran war will end 'immediately' after midterm elections
english: Donald Trump claimed that tensions with Iran will resolve quickly following the upcoming midterm elections because the country is struggling significantly. He accused Tehran of attempting to influence the US voting process while maintaining his stance against them acquiring nuclear weapons. Although he stated he is not currently seeking formal talks, he did not rule out the possibility of future negotiations.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ያለው ውጥረት በመካከለኛው ዘመን ምርጫ ማግስት እንደሚቋጭ ተናግረዋል። ኢራን በከባድ ችግር ውስጥ በመሆኗ በምርጫው ላይ ተጽዕኖ ለማሳደር እየሞከረች እንደሆነም ከሰዋል። በአሁኑ ሰዓት ድርድር ባይፈልጉም ለወደፊቱ ግን ዕድሉ ክፍት እንደሆነ ገልጸው፣ ሀገሪቱ የኑክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ያላቸውን አቋም ደግመዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump rakkoon Iran waliin jiru filannoo giddu galeessaa booda dafee akka furamu dubbate. Iran rakkoo keessa waan jirtuuf filannoo Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf yaalaa jirti jechuun himate. Ammaaf marii tokkollee kan hin barbaadne ta'us, gara fuulduraatti mariin jiraachuu akka danda'u ibsee, Iran meeshaa niwukilaraa akka hin arganneef yaada isaa cimsee dubbate.

title: Syria condemns Netanyahu's 'illegal' entry into its territory
english: Syrian officials have officially denounced Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for visiting military forces stationed in the southern part of their country. The government described his inspection of the Mount Hermon area as an illegal act that disregards international law and national sovereignty. Syria considers this high-level visit a deliberate provocation against their territorial integrity.
amharic: የሶሪያ መንግሥት የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በሶሪያ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኙ ወታደሮች መጎብኘታቸውን በጽኑ አውግዘዋል። ሶሪያ ይህን ድርጊት የአገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት እና የዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የጣሰ ህገ-ወጥ እና አነሳሽ ተግባር ሲል ገልጾታል። መንግሥቱ ኔታንያሁ በተራራ ሄርሞን አካባቢ ያደረጉት ጉብኝት የአገሪቱን የግዛት አንድነት የሚፈታተን መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Suoriyaa, muummeen ministiraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun waraana biyyattii gama kibbaatti argamu daawwachuu isaanii jabeessee balaaleffateera. Mootummaan kun daawwannaa Netanyaahuun gara gaara Hermonitti taasisan, seera idil-addunyaa fi mirga abbaa biyyummaa Suoriyaa kan cabsu gocha seeraan alaa fi kan kakaasudha jechuun ibseera. Gochi kun nageenyaa fi mirga daangaa biyyattii kan sarbu ta'uu Suoriyaan ibsiteetti.

title: Saudi-led coalition in Yemen says Houthis attacked three Saudi Arabian cities
english: The Saudi-led coalition reported that Houthi forces launched ballistic missiles and drone strikes against three cities in southwestern Saudi Arabia. The targeted locations included Khamis Mushait, Abha, and Jazan. Although emergency warnings were briefly issued for some of these areas, authorities later lifted the alerts following the attacks.
amharic: የሳውዲ ጥምር ኃይል የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ደቡብ ምዕራብ በሚገኙ ሶስት ከተሞች ላይ በባለስቲክ ሚሳኤል እና በድሮን ጥቃት ማድረሳቸውን አስታውቋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው በካሚስ ሙሻይት፣ በአብሃ እና በጃዛን ከተሞች ላይ ነው። ለተወሰነ ጊዜ በአካባቢው የነበረው የአደጋ ማስጠንቀቂያ ከጥቃቱ በኋላ እንዲነሳ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii durfamu gareen Hutiin magaalonni Kibba-Dhiha Saudii Arabaa sadii irratti weerara misayilaa fi xiyyaara maleeyyuun (drone) raawwatamuu ibseera. title: Iran says IAEA resolution 'will not bring any results'
english: Iran has rejected a new IAEA resolution that refers the country to the UN Security Council regarding its nuclear activities. Iranian officials argue that the resolution is politically motivated by the U.S. and its allies and follows interference with their nuclear facilities. Tehran stated that this move is ineffective and will not lead to any meaningful results.

Teheran akka jedhetti, tarkiinni kun bu'aa kan hin qabne fi kan hin milkoofne akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
english: Google has announced a record €13 billion investment in Finland to expand its artificial intelligence infrastructure, marking its largest single investment in Europe. The plan includes building three new data centers and securing a long-term agreement to use nuclear power from the Loviisa plant. This initiative is expected to boost the local economy significantly, create thousands of jobs, and support the growing energy needs of Google’s global services.
amharic: ጎግል በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ መሠረተ ልማቱን ለማስፋፋት በፊንላንድ 13 ቢሊዮን ዩሮ ኢንቨስት እንደሚያደርግ አስታውቋል፤ ይህም ኩባንያው በአውሮፓ ያደረገው ትልቁ ነጠላ የኢንቨስትመንት ድርሻ ነው። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ሶስት አዳዲስ የመረጃ ማዕከላትን መገንባትን እና ከሎቪሳ የኒውክሌር ኃይል ማመንጫ ለረጅም ጊዜ የሚቆይ የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦት ስምምነትን ያካትታል። ይህ ኢንቨስትመንት የፊንላንድን ኢኮኖሚ ከማሳደጉም በላይ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የስራ እድሎችን በመፍጠር ለጎግል አገልግሎቶች የሚያስፈልገውን የኃይል ፍላጎት ለማሟላት ይረዳል።
oromo: Google bu'uuraalee misoomaa 'artificial intelligence' babal'isuuf biyya Finlanditti Yuuroo biliyoona 13 baasii gochuuf akka jiru beeksiseera; kunis invastimantii guddicha Google Awurooppaatti godhe dha. Karoorri kun giddugala odeeffannoo haaraa sadii ijaaruu fi anniisaa niwukilaraa buufata Loviisa irraa argamu fayyadamuuf waliigaltee dheeraa mallatteessuu of keessatti qabata. Invastimantiin kun diinagdee biyyattii guddisee fi carraa hojii kumaatamaan lakkaawwamu uumuu dabalatee, fedhii anniisaa tajaajila Google addunyaa irratti dabalaa jiru guutuuf gargaara.

title: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
english: European royalty, world leaders, and thousands of Norwegian citizens gathered in Oslo to honor the late King Harald V. Following his death at age 89, a formal procession carried the monarch to his final resting place at Akershus Fortress after 35 years of reign. His son, King Haakon, has now assumed the throne and was joined by global dignitaries to pay tribute to his father's legacy as a modernizing leader.

oromo: Maatiin mootota Awurooppaa, hogganoonni addunyaa fi uummanni Norwee kumaatamaan lakka'aman, Oslo keessatti sirna awwaalcha mootii Harald V irratti argamuun kabaja isaanii ibsaniiru. Umuriisaanii waggaa 89tti kan boqotan mootichi, waggaa 35f biyyattii erga bulchanii booda, sirna kabaja qabuun gara gamoo Akershusitti raawwatameera. Ilmi isaanii mootii Haakon taayitaa erga qabatanii booda, qaamolee mootummoota addunyaa waliin ta'uun kabaja isaanii ibsataniiru.

title: 78 people including newborn rescued in Mediterranean
english: A rescue organization successfully saved 78 individuals, including a newborn baby, from the Mediterranean Sea on Tuesday. The rescue took place across three separate operations to assist those in distress. Many of the survivors were found suffering from severe dehydration, heat exhaustion, and chemical burns caused by fuel.

title: Attackers kill police officer, kidnap teachers in Cameroon’s northwest
english: An armed group raided a teacher training facility in Wum, Cameroon, resulting in the death of a police officer who tried to intervene. The attackers successfully kidnapped five teachers and fled to an unknown location. This violent incident is part of a long-standing separatist conflict in the nation's English-speaking regions that has caused significant loss of life and displacement since 2017.

title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
english: Following the AfD's significant election win in Saxony-Anhalt, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz engaged in a heated parliamentary debate with party leader Alice Weidel. Merz strongly criticized the far-right group, labeling their proposed migration policies as a destructive form of ethnic cleansing that threatens the nation's skilled workforce. Meanwhile, the AfD argued that the election results demonstrate a clear failure of the current government's leadership.

title: Russia and Ukraine exchange strikes as two killed at Moldova border
english: Russian drone strikes on a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova resulted in two deaths and the closure of the site. Simultaneously, a Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian city of Novorossiysk killed four people and caused significant damage to civilian infrastructure. These escalations occurred despite ongoing international diplomatic discussions aimed at reaching a ceasefire in the conflict.

title: N Korea has built two-storey uranium enrichment facility, says watchdog
english: The International Atomic Energy Agency has reported that North Korea is expanding its nuclear capabilities by constructing a new two-story uranium enrichment facility at the Yongbyon complex. This development, along with signs of increased activity at the Kangson site, signifies a clear violation of UN resolutions according to the agency's director. Despite facing significant economic challenges, North Korea continues to invest heavily in its secretive nuclear weapons program.

title: Dortmund’s Karetsas hospitalised after collapsing in Champions League match
english: Eighteen-year-old Borussia Dortmund midfielder Konstantinos Karetsas was hospitalized after collapsing on the pitch during his Champions League debut against Villarreal. The Greek teenager experienced circulatory issues while playing, prompting medical staff to remove him from the game on a stretcher. Club officials confirmed that he is currently stable and undergoing further medical evaluations to ensure his recovery.

oromo: Taphatni kilabii Boorusiiya Dootmunt Konstantinos Karetsas tapha Chaampiyoons Liigii Viyaareel irratti osoo taphatuu erga kufee booda gara hospitaalaatti geeffameera. dargaggeessi umriin isaa waggaa 18 ta'e kun rakkoo dhiibbaa dhiigaa mudateen erga lafa irratti kufee booda, gareen fayyaa isa kaasee gara hospitaalaatti geesseera. Bulchiinsi kilabichaa akka ibsetti, haalli fayyaa isaa tasgabbaa’aa fi qorannoon dabalataa irratti godhamaa jiraachuu beekameera.

title: Nigeria, Boko Haram reportedly reach secret three-month ceasefire
english: Reports suggest that the Nigerian government and Boko Haram have been maintaining a secret three-month ceasefire following a negotiation that secured the release of 360 abducted villagers. While the deal reportedly involved a multimillion-dollar payment to the group, the government has denied paying any ransom. This truce, which excludes other rival militant factions, remains unverified by official authorities who publicly maintain a policy against negotiating with the insurgent group.
amharic: የናይጄሪያ መንግስት እና ቦኮ ሃራም በድብቅ የሶስት ወር የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ማድረጋቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህ ስምምነት የተደረሰው ታፍነው የነበሩ 360 መንደርተኞችን ለመልቀቅ በተደረገ ድርድር ሲሆን መንግስት ለዚህ ክፍያ መፈጸሙን ቢክድም የገንዘብ ክፍያ መፈጸሙ እየተነገረ ነው። በሌሎች የታጠቁ ቡድኖች ላይ የማይሰራው ይህ ድብቅ ስምምነት በመንግስት በኩል በይፋ የተረጋገጠ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Mootummaan Naayijeeriyaa fi gareen Bokoo Haraam, namoota 360 butamanii turan gadhiisiisuuf walii galtee dhokataa ji'a sadii turu irra gahuun gabaasameera. Walii galtee kanaaf kaffaltiin guddaan raawwatameera jedhamus, mootummaan yakka kana haaleera. Walii galteen kun gareewwan biroo kan hin dabalatuufi hanga ammaatti mootummaan biyyattii irraa mirkanaa'e kan hin jirre ta'uu beekameera.

title: At least 14 killed in weapons depot blast in Syria’s Idlib, state TV says
english: At least 14 people were killed and 11 others injured following a massive explosion at a weapons storage site near the Syrian city of Sarmada. Emergency responders are currently searching for survivors amidst the rubble, though their efforts have been delayed by secondary blasts. While the exact cause of the incident remains unknown, the site was being used to store munitions left over from Syria's long-standing civil war.
amharic: በሶሪያ ኢድሊብ ግዛት ሳርማዳ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የጦር መሳሪያ ማከማቻ ቦታ በደረሰ ፍንዳታ ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 11 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሠራተኞች በተፈጠረው ተከታታይ ፍንዳታ ምክንያት በፍለጋ ሥራቸው ላይ ችግር ቢገጥማቸውም የተረፉ ሰዎችን ፍለጋ ቀጥለዋል። የፍንዳታው ትክክለኛ ምክንያት እስካሁን ባይታወቅም፣ መጋዘኑ የሶሪያ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ከተጠናቀቀ በኋላ የቀሩ መሳሪያዎች የሚቀመጡበት ቦታ እንደነበር ተገልጿል።
oromo: Siriyaa, ganda Sarmadaa jedhamu biratti bakka meeshaalee waraanaa kuufaman tokko irratti bubu'aan guddaan mudatee namoota 14 ol ta'an du'aniiru, 11 immoo madaa'aniiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa diigama jala namoota jiran barbaacha jiruus, bubu'aan lammaffaa hojii isaanii dadhabsiiseera. Sababiin bubu'ichaa hanga ammaatti kan hin beekamne ta'us, bakki kun waraana keessa biyyaa Siriyaatti booda meeshaalee hafan itti kuufatanii turan.

title: Journalists missing after Indonesian volcanic eruption
english: Five journalists have gone missing in Indonesia while they were reporting on the recent eruption of the Mount Anak Krakatoa volcano. Emergency response teams are currently carrying out search and rescue operations to locate the group. The authorities are working to find the missing reporters following the dangerous volcanic activity.

title: AI researcher quits Anthropic saying AI race ‘could kill us all’
english: A researcher has left the artificial intelligence company Anthropic due to concerns about the industry's rapid pace of development. They cautioned that the push to create superintelligent technology could lead to systems that operate beyond human oversight. This resignation highlights growing fears that uncontrolled AI progress may pose a significant danger to humanity.
amharic: አንድ ተመራማሪ በዘርፉ እየታየ ያለውን ፈጣን የእድገት ሩጫ በመቃወም ከአንትሮፒክ (Anthropic) ኩባንያ ለቀዋል። ተመራማሪው ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ከሰው ቁጥጥር ውጪ በሆነ መንገድ ሊያድግ እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህም ያልተገደበ የቴክኖሎጂ እድገት በሰው ልጅ ላይ ትልቅ ስጋት ሊፈጥር እንደሚችል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: qorataan tokko saffisa guddina teeknoolojii 'artificially intelligent' (AI) irratti mul'atuun walqabatee kampanii 'Anthropic' jedhamu gadhiiseera.
