Tarkaanfiin kun guddinni AI to'annoo malee itti fufuun isaa gara fuulduraatti balaa guddaa namoota irraan ga'uu akka danda'u yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
english: Global oil prices have climbed above $100 per barrel for the first time since July due to escalating military tensions between the US and Iran. The ongoing conflict includes retaliatory strikes and Houthi attacks on oil facilities and tankers, which threaten key supply routes like the Strait of Hormuz. These geopolitical disruptions have caused significant instability in energy markets and are leading to higher fuel costs for consumers worldwide.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ወታደራዊ ውጥረት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ የዓለም የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከሐምሌ ወር ወዲህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ከአንድ መቶ ዶላር በላይ ሆኗል። እየተካሄዱ ያሉት የአጸፋ ጥቃቶች እና በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚፈጸሙ ድርጊቶች እንደ ሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ያሉ ወሳኝ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መንገዶችን ስጋት ላይ ጥለዋል። እነዚህ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የተፈጠሩ ግጭቶች በነዳጅ ገበያው ላይ መዋዠቅን በመፍጠር በዓለም ዙሪያ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲጨምር እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waraana fi wal-dhabiinsa gidduu Ameerikaa fi Iraan jiru irraa kan ka'e, gatiin boba'aa addunyaa ji'a Muddeerraa kaasee yeroo jalqabaaf doolaara dhibba tokko ol dabreera. Hojiiwwan waraanaa fi weerara gareen Huutii buufataalee fi dooniiwwan boba'aa irratti raawwatan, daandiiwwan boba'aa bakka tokkoo gara birootti geessan kan akka Hormuz sodaa keessa galcheera. Wal-dhabiinsi kun gabaa boba'aa addunyaa irratti tasgabbii dhabuu fi gatiin boba'aa guutuu addunyaatti akka ol ka'u taasiseera.

title: Tycoon to pay ex-wife $1.87bn in record South Korea divorce settlement
english: A South Korean court has ordered gaming mogul Kwon Hyuk-bin to pay his former wife $1.87 billion, setting a new record for the largest divorce settlement in the nation's history. The ruling requires Kwon to transfer a 35% stake in his company, Smilegate, along with a significant cash payment to his ex-spouse. Lee Hwa-jin argued that she contributed to the company's early success and managed their family life for over two decades, though both parties maintain the right to appeal the decision.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቪዲዮ ጨዋታ ኩባንያ መስራች የሆነው ክዎን ሂዩክ-ቢን ለቀድሞ ባለቤቱ ሊ ህዋ-ጂን 1.87 ቢሊዮን ዶላር እንዲከፍል ትዕዛዝ ሰጥቷል፤ ይህ ውሳኔ በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ ትልቁ የፍቺ ካሳ ክፍያ ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ክዎን የኩባንያውን የ35 በመቶ ድርሻ ለቀድሞ ባለቤቱ እንዲያስተላልፍ እና በተጨማሪም በጥሬ ገንዘብ እንዲከፍል ወስኗል። እመቤት ሊ የኩባንያውን የመጀመሪያ ስኬት በመደገፍ እና ቤተሰባቸውን ለረጅም አመታት በመንከባከብ ድርሻ እንደነበራት በማስረዳቷ ፍርድ ቤቱ ለሷ ወግኗል፤ ሆኖም ሁለቱም ወገኖች በውሳኔው ላይ ይግባኝ የመጠየቅ መብት አላቸው።
oromo: Mana murtii Koriyaa Kibbaa, abbaan qabeenyaa fi hundeesituun kampanii tapha viidiyoo Kwon Hyuk-bin, haadha manaa isaa duraanii turteef kaffaltii hiikkaa gaa’elaa biyyattii keessatti hanga ammaatti mul’ate keessaa kan hunda caalu doolaara biiliyoona 1.87 akka kaffalu ajajeera. Murtii kanaan Kwon qooda kampanii isaa Smilegate keessaa dhibbeentaa 35 fi maallaqa dabalataa tokko akka dabarsee kennu dirqameera. Lee Hwa-jin hundeeffama kampanichaa irratti gahee akka qabduu fi waggoota dheeraaf maatii ishee akka kunuunsitu himattee turte, ta’us gamtaan lamaanuu murtiichaa irratti iyyata dhiyeeffachuu ni danda’u.

title: Meta continues to run ads promoting child sexual abuse material in India - report
english: A report from the Tech Transparency Project reveals that Meta's platforms, Facebook and Instagram, continue to host paid advertisements featuring AI-generated child sexual abuse material. Despite previous government warnings and orders to remove such content in India, hundreds of these harmful ads have surfaced on the platforms over the past ten months. Meta claims it is actively working to detect and remove these materials, though experts argue that the company's enforcement efforts remain insufficient.
amharic: የቴክኖሎጂ ግልጽነት ፕሮጀክት እንደገለጸው፣ የሜታ ኩባንያ ድረ-ገጾች የሆኑት ፌስቡክ እና ኢንስታግራም በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የተፈጠሩ ህጻናትን በጾታ የሚበዘብዙ ይዘቶችን ማስተዋወቂያዎችን ማስተናገዳቸውን ቀጥለዋል። የህንድ መንግስት ይህን መሰል ይዘቶች እንዲወገዱ ጥብቅ ትዕዛዝ ቢሰጥም፣ ባለፉት አስር ወራት ውስጥ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ጎጂ ማስታወቂያዎች በድረ-ገጾቹ ላይ ታይተዋል። ሜታ ይዘቶቹን ለመቆጣጠር እየሰራሁ ነው ቢልም፣ ባለሙያዎች የኩባንያው የክትትል ስራዎች ውጤታማ እንዳልሆኑ ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Gabaasni 'Tech Transparency Project' jedhamu akka ibsetti, miidiyaaleen hawaasaa Meta, Facebook fi Instagram, suuraalee fi viidiyoolee AI fayyadamuun daa'imman irratti miidhaa saalqunnamtii raawwatamu agarsiisan kafaltiidhaan gabaasuuf tajaajilaa jiru. Mootummaan Indiyaa qabiyyee akkasii kana akka dhaabsisan ajajee tureyyuu, baatii kudhan darban keessa beeksisoonni miidhaa qaban dhibbaan lakkaa'aman sadarkaa kanatti mul'ataniiru. Meta qabiyyee kana ittisuuf hojjetaa akka jiru yoo ibsu, ogeeyyonni garuu tarkaanfiin kambaniin sun fudhachaa jiru gahaa miti jechuun mormu.

title: Flash floods surge through Morocco’s Atlas Mountains
english: Severe flash floods recently hit Morocco's Atlas Mountains following intense rainfall. The flooding occurred near the Oum Er-Rbia springs in the Khenifra region, causing significant damage to local tourist facilities. Authorities are monitoring the situation as the surge of water disrupted the area.
amharic: በሞሮኮ የአትላስ ተራሮች አካባቢ በጣለው ከፍተኛ ዝናብ ሳቢያ ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ ተከስቷል። ጎርፉ በኬኒፍራ ክልል በሚገኘው የኦም ኤር-ርቢያ ምንጮች አካባቢ የተከሰተ ሲሆን በአካባቢው የሚገኙ የቱሪስት መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ባለስልጣናት የጎርፉን አደጋ ሁኔታ እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaa Morokoo keessatti gaarreen Atlasitti rooba cimaa roobeen lolaan tasaa uumameera. Lolaan kun naannoo Khenifraatti kan argamu burqaa Oum Er-Rbia irratti kan dhufe yoo ta'u, bu'uuraalee misooma tuurizimii naannichaa irratti miidha guddaa qaqqabsiiseera. Aangoo qabeeyyiin haala lolaa kanaa hordofaa jiru.

title: In maps and charts: Russian and Ukrainian attacks on civilian targets
english: As the Russia-Ukraine war enters its fifth year, data shows that attacks on civilian infrastructure by both sides have more than doubled. Recently, U.S. envoys visited Moscow and Kyiv to push for peace talks, but no major breakthroughs were achieved following a period of intense Russian airstrikes. Both nations are increasingly using long-range drones to strike targets far beyond the front lines, with officials warning of further threats to energy grids as winter approaches.
amharic: የሩሲያና የዩክሬን ጦርነት አምስተኛ ዓመቱን ሲይዝ፣ በሁለቱም ወገኖች በሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች በእጥፍ መጨመራቸው ተረጋግጧል። በቅርቡ የአሜሪካ መልዕክተኞች በሞስኮ እና በኪየቭ የሰላም ንግግሮችን ለማስቀጠል ጉብኝት ቢያደርጉም፣ ከባድ የአየር ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ ምንም አይነት ጉልህ ለውጥ አልታየም። ሁለቱም ሀገራት ከግንባር ውጭ ባሉ ቦታዎች የድሮን ጥቃቶችን በማብዛታቸው፣ ክረምቱ እየቀረበ ሲመጣ በሃይል አቅርቦት ላይ የከፋ አደጋ ሊደርስ እንደሚችል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Waraanni Ruusiyaa fi Yukreen waggaa shanaffaatti yeroo ce'utti, haleellaan bu'uraalee misoomaa siviilotaa irratti gama lamaanuun raawwatamu dachaan dabaluun isaa qorannoon mirkaneesseera. Ergamtootni Ameerikaa nageenya buusuuf gara Moskoo fi Kiyeev imaluus, haleellaa qilleensa irraa booda furmaanni argamu hin danda'amne. Gamni lamaanuu dronoowwan fageeffaqaatti fayyadamuun naannoo waraanaa irraa fagoo haleellaa raawwachaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, qilleensi qorri yeroo dhihaatutti miidhaan buufataalee anniisaa irratti qaqqabu sodaachisaa jira.

title: Video: Protesters shut down UNHCR headquarters in Tripoli, Libya
english: Demonstrators have forced the closure of the UN refugee agency's main office in Tripoli, Libya. The protest was driven by public anger regarding the agency's efforts to resettle undocumented migrants within the country. This action marks the culmination of months of local opposition against the UN's migration policies in the region.
amharic: በሊቢያ ትሪፖሊ የሚገኘው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የስደተኞች ጉዳይ ከፍተኛ ኮሚሽን ቢሮ በተቃዋሚዎች ተዘግቷል። ተቃውሞው የተነሳው ድርጅቱ ህገ-ወጥ ስደተኞችን በሊቢያ ውስጥ ለማስፈር የሚያደርገውን ጥረት በመቃወም ነው። ይህ ድርጊት በስደተኞች አያያዝ ዙሪያ ለወራት ሲካሄድ የቆየውን የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ተቃውሞ ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Hiriirtonni waajjira guddaa dhaabbata baqattootaa kan Mootummoota Gamtoomanii kan magaalaa Tripoli, Libiyaa keessatti argamu cufuun isaanii gabaafameera. Hiriirri kun kan ka'e, dhaabbatichi baqattoota seeraan alaa biyyattii keessatti qubachiisuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru mormuufidha. Tarkaanfiin kunis mormii baatiiwwan hedduuf jiraattonni naannichaa dhaabbaticharratti qabaataa turan kan agarsiisuudha.

title: ‘Totally reliant on Mother Nature’: UK drought raises water security fears
english: Severe heatwaves and prolonged drought have devastated harvests across the United Kingdom, leading to significantly lower crop yields and financial instability for many farmers. With reservoir levels dropping and rainfall hitting record lows, agricultural production faces a major crisis that threatens the nation's food security. Farmers are struggling with reduced income and rising costs, warning that continued extreme weather could force them to scale back future operations.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን እና ረጅም ድርቅ በሰብል ምርት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት በማድረሱ አርሶ አደሮች ለከባድ የገንዘብ ችግር ተዳርገዋል። የውሃ ማጠራቀሚያዎች መጠን መቀነስ እና የዝናብ እጥረት ለሀገሪቱ የምግብ ዋስትና ስጋት ፈጥሯል። አርሶ አደሮች የገቢ መቀነስ እና የወጪ ጭማሪ እየገጠማቸው ሲሆን፣ የአየር ንብረት ችግሩ ከቀጠለ ምርታቸውን ለመቀነስ እንደሚገደዱ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Onkoleessa cimaa fi hongee dheeraa ta’een biyya Ingiliz keessatti oomishni qonnaa miidhamuun qotee bulaan hedduun rakkoo dinagdee keessa galaniiru. Sadarkaan bishaan bakka kuusaa hir’achuu fi roobni gadi bu’uu isaa wal qabatee, nageenyi nyaataa biyyattii yaaddoo keessa galeera. Qotee bulaan rakkoo galiin wal qabatuu fi gatiin xaa'oo fi boba'aa dabaluu isaa kan himan yoo ta'u, haalli qilleensaa kun yoo itti fufe gara fuulduraatti oomisha isaanii gadi xiqqusuuf akka dirqaman hubachiisaniiru.

title: Russian drone attack kills two at Ukraine-Moldova border crossing
english: A Russian drone strike on a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova has resulted in the deaths of two people and left three others injured. The attack caused a significant fire and forced a temporary suspension of all passenger and vehicle traffic at the site. Simultaneously, Russia conducted a series of overnight air raids targeting Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions, causing widespread damage to infrastructure.
amharic: በዩክሬን እና በሞልዶቫ ድንበር ላይ በደረሰ የሩሲያ ድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ ሌሎች ሶስት ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ ትልቅ የእሳት አደጋ በማስከተሉ ድንበሩ ላይ የነበረው የሰዎች እና የተሽከርካሪዎች እንቅስቃሴ ለጊዜው እንዲቆም ተደርጓል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ ሩሲያ በኪየቭ እና በሌሎች የዩክሬን አካባቢዎች የአየር ጥቃቶችን በመፈጸም በመሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሳለች።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaa daangaa Yukreen fi Moldoovaa gidduutti argamu irratti weerara doonii (drone) gaggeesseen namootni lama du'anii sadii immoo madaa'aniiru. Weerarichi ibidda guddaa kaasuun isaa fi konkolaataa fi namoota daangicha darban ittisuun isaa gabaafameera. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, Ruusiyaan magaalaa Kiyeev fi naannolee biroo irratti weerara qilleensa irraa gaggeessuun miidhaa bu'uraalee misoomaa irratti geessisteerti.

title: European gas prices reach highest level since 2022
english: Natural gas costs in Europe have climbed by 4 percent, reaching €79 per megawatt-hour. This marks the most significant price increase for the fuel since the end of 2022. Market analysts are closely monitoring these rising figures as they approach levels not seen in over a year.
amharic: በአውሮፓ የጋዝ ዋጋ በአራት በመቶ ጭማሪ በማሳየት በአንድ ሜጋ ዋት በሰዓት 79 ዩሮ ደርሷል። ይህ ጭማሪ ከ2022 መጨረሻ ወዲህ ከፍተኛው ደረጃ ላይ የደረሰ ነው። የገበያ ተንታኞች ከዓመት በላይ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ሁኔታ እየጨመረ የመጣውን ይህንን የዋጋ መጠን በጥንቃቄ እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gatiin gaasii biyyoota Awurooppaa keessatti dhibbeentaa afuriin dabaluun, sa’aatii tokkoof meegaawaattii 79 Euro ga’eera. Kunis gatiin gaasii bara 2022 dhuma irraa jalqabee sadarkaa ol’aanaa irra ga’e dha. Hayyoonni gabaa gatiin kun waggaa tokko oliif mul’atee hin beekne waan ta’eef, xiyyeeffannoon hordofaa jiru.

title: Pakistan and Egypt discuss escalating regional attacks
english: Pakistan and Egypt are coordinating their efforts to address the rising tensions and violence throughout the Middle East. The foreign ministers of both nations held a phone call to discuss the situation and agreed to meet again during the upcoming UN General Assembly. Pakistan is emphasizing the need for collaboration with Saudi Arabia and Turkiye, building on its recent history of mediating regional conflicts.
amharic: ፓኪስታን እና ግብፅ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት እና ውጥረት ለመወያየት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። የሁለቱ አገራት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በስልክ ተነጋግረው፣ በቀጣዩ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ በአካል ለመገናኘት ተስማምተዋል። ፓኪስታን ቀደም ሲል በክልሉ ለነበሩ ግጭቶች አማላጅነት ሚና ስትጫወት እንደመሆኗ፣ አሁን ከሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ከቱርክ ጋር በቅርበት መስራት እንደሚያስፈልግ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Paakistaanii fi Gibtsi naannoo Baha Giddugaleessatti walitti bu'iinsa dabalaa jiru furuuf mari'achaa jiru. Ministiroonni dhimmi alaa biyyoota lamaanii bilbilan wal-qunnamanii, gaaffii wal-ga'ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa dhufu irratti waltajjiitti wal arguuf waliigalaniru. Paakistaan biyyoota akka Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Turkeetti waliin mari'achuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsuun, gama isheenis kanaan dura giddu-galeessa ta'uun lola tasgabbeessuuf carraaqqii gochaa turte itti fufuuf fedhii qabdi.

title: Qatar and Pakistan carry Trump’s message to Iran: He won't return to the MoU
english: President Donald Trump has signaled through officials from Pakistan and Qatar that he will not adhere to the June Memorandum of Understanding with Iran. This decision follows domestic political pressure in Washington and ongoing regional military tensions, including disputes over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. While Iran preferred to keep the original agreement for its economic and security benefits, Trump is now pushing for an entirely new negotiation framework.

oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp, biyyoota Paakistaanii fi Qaaxar fayyadamuun walii galtee ji'a Waxabajjii Iran waliin godhame akka hin kabajne beeksisaniiru. Murteen kun dhiibbaa siyaasaa keessoo Ameerikaa fi jeequmsa naannoo, keessattuu walii galtee daandii galaana Hormuz irratti uumameen kan dhufedha. title: Exclusive: British Museum's Bayeux Tapestry sponsor backs Israeli defence tech fund
english: The British Museum is hosting a major exhibition featuring the Bayeux Tapestry, supported by a significant £5 million donation from billionaire Igor Tulchinsky. However, the museum is facing scrutiny because Tulchinsky also leads an investment fund in Israel that focuses on defense technologies. This connection has sparked controversy, especially as the museum already faces pressure regarding its previous handling of exhibitions related to Palestine and other contested sponsorships.

Haata’u malee, Tulchiinskiin Israa’el keessatti dhaabbata teeknoolojii ittisaa irratti hojjetu keessatti hirmaannaa qabaachuun isaa muuziyeemicha komii fi qeeqaf saaxilee jira. title: RSF drone strikes shatter sense of optimism in Sudan's el-Obeid
english: Residents of el-Obeid recently faced renewed drone attacks by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), abruptly ending a brief period of optimism caused by the partial lifting of a siege and the arrival of the rainy season. Although the city has endured years of conflict and infrastructure damage, locals remain determined to stay in their homes despite the targeted aggression. Humanitarian observers suggest these strikes are a deliberate tactic by the RSF to terrorize and displace the civilian population.
amharic: በሱዳን ኤል-ኦቤይድ ከተማ የነበረው መጠነኛ የተስፋ ስሜት በፈጣን ድጋፍ ሰጪ ኃይሎች (RSF) በደረሰው ድንገተኛ የድሮን ጥቃት ተስተጓጉሏል። ከተማዋ ለረጅም ጊዜ በከበባ ስትሰቃይ ብትቆይም፣ ነዋሪዎቹ በማንኛውም ሁኔታ ከከተማዋ ለመውጣት ፈቃደኛ አይደሉም። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች እንደሚሉት፣ እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የሲቪል ህዝቡን ለማፈናቀል እና ስጋት ለመፍጠር የታለመ ስልታዊ እርምጃ ናቸው።
oromo: Magalaan el-Obeid yeroodhaaf abdii guddaa qabduu turte, erga humnoonni RSF haleellaa xiyyaaroota to'annoo malee (drones) gaggeessaniin booda badii guddaaf saaxilamte. Jiraattonni magaalattii waggoota hedduuf rakkoo waraanaafi hiyyumma keessa turanillee, manaa fi qe'ee isaanii gadi lakkisuu diduun jabaatanii jiru. Akka gabaasichi ibsutti, haleellaan kun kaayyoon isaa gurguddaan uummata sodaachisuufi dirqiin godaansisuu akka ta'e dubbatama.

title: Exam Reforms Aren’t Fixing Ethiopia’s Institutional Decay
english: Despite recent government efforts to tighten exam security and reduce cheating in Ethiopia, the country's education system is struggling to foster genuine honesty and integrity. While moving exams to universities drastically cut down on dishonesty, the resulting high failure rates reveal that many students lack the necessary academic foundation and moral preparation. Ultimately, schools are failing to teach essential values, as the 'hidden curriculum' often rewards shortcuts and surface-level performance over deep learning and character development.

title: The case for the US going back to the firing squad
english: The United States is currently facing significant challenges in carrying out lethal injections due to medical ethics concerns and a lack of necessary drugs. To address these difficulties, some experts are suggesting that the country should reintroduce the firing squad as a method of execution. This debate highlights the ongoing struggle to find reliable and acceptable ways to conduct capital punishment.

title: Cluster munitions kill, wound over 1,000 globally in 2025
english: A recent global report indicates that over 1,000 people were killed or injured by cluster munitions in 2025, marking one of the deadliest years on record. Ukraine accounted for the vast majority of these casualties, which primarily affected civilians, including many children. Despite an international treaty prohibiting these weapons, several nations continue to produce and use them, making post-conflict areas extremely dangerous.

oromo: Gabaasni haaraan tokko akka ibsutti, bara 2025 keessa namoonni 1,000 ol ta'an bomii 'cluster' jedhamuun miidhamuu fi du'uu isaanii ibseera. title: Conflict over Taiwan would be disastrous, de facto US ambassador warns
english: Raymond Greene, the top U.S. diplomat in Taiwan, has warned that any potential conflict in the Taiwan Strait would cause catastrophic global economic damage far worse than World War II. Ahead of a crucial summit between President Trump and President Xi Jinping, Greene emphasized that the U.S. is prioritizing peace through strong diplomacy and by helping Taiwan strengthen its own self-defense capabilities. The U.S. remains committed to maintaining stability in the region to prevent military misunderstandings between the two global powers.

oromo: Hoggantoonni diplomaata Amerikaa kan Taaywaanitti argaman Raymond Greene, waraanni yoo naannoo galaana Taaywaanitti dhalate miidhaan inni diinagdee addunyaarratti geessisu waraana addunyaa lammaffaa irra kan hammaatu ta'uu akeekkachiisaniiru. english: A video has emerged showing a roadside attack on Yemeni government forces traveling through the Hodeidah region. Suspected Houthi fighters launched an ambush on the convoy, resulting in one death and multiple injuries. The incident highlights the ongoing instability and violent conflict taking place in this part of Yemen.

oromo: Mootummaan Yemen, godina Hodeida keessa osoo imalaa jiruu, garee shakkamtoota Huthitiin miidhaan akka irra ga'e viidiyoon ragaa baheera. Haleellaa karaa irraatti baname kanaan lubbuun nama tokkoo yoo darbu, namoonni biroo hedduun miidhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii keessatti rakkoon nageenyaa fi walitti bu'iinsi hammataa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Gambian leader pledges halt to rolling blackouts as protests turn violent
english: Gambian President Adama Barrow has promised to resolve the country's severe electricity crisis following violent protests over prolonged power outages. To address the situation, the government plans to install a new 24-megawatt power plant by October and begin work on a solar energy facility. These blackouts, which have lasted up to two days, have triggered public unrest just months before the upcoming presidential election.
amharic: የጋምቢያው ፕሬዝዳንት አዳማ ባሮ ለረጅም ጊዜ በዘለቁት የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ ምክንያት በተቀሰቀሰው አመጽ ተከትሎ ችግሩን ለመፍታት ቃል ገብተዋል። መንግሥት እስከ ጥቅምት ወር መጨረሻ ድረስ የ24 ሜጋ ዋት የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ እንደሚተክል እና ተጨማሪ የፀሐይ ኃይል ማመንጫ ፕሮጀክት እንደሚጀምር አስታውቋል። እስከ ሁለት ቀናት ሊቆይ የቻለው የኤሌክትሪክ እጥረት በሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለታቀደው የፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ ጥቂት ወራት ሲቀረው መከሰቱ የፖለቲካ ውጥረትን ጨምሯል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Gaambiyaa Adaamaa Baaroo rakkoo hanqina ibsaa biyyattii mudatee ture hordofee mormii cimaa uumame erga tasgabbaa’ee booda rakkoon kun akka furamu waadaa galaniiru. Mootummaan hanga dhuma ji’a Fulbaanaatti maashinii anniisaa meegawaatii 24 ta’u akka dhaabuufi karoora anniisaa aduutiin ibsaa argachuuf hojiin akka eegalamu beeksiseera. Hanga guyyaa lamaa kan turee fi ummata dheekkamsiise ibsaa dhabuun kun, filannoo pireezidaantummaa dhufuuf ji’oota muraasa qofa osoo hafe ta’uun isaa dhiibbaa siyaasaa uumeera.

title: US slaps import ban on Canadian alcohol and other goods
english: President Donald Trump has ordered a ban on various Canadian imports, including vehicles, dairy, and alcohol, starting late September. This move follows Canada's decision to place retaliatory tariffs on American goods in response to previous US taxes on Canadian products. While both nations acknowledge that these trade conflicts carry economic consequences, there are currently no new negotiations planned to resolve the dispute.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከመስከረም መጨረሻ ጀምሮ ተግባራዊ የሚሆን የተለያዩ የካናዳ ምርቶችን ማለትም መኪናዎችን፣ የወተት ተዋጽኦዎችን እና አልኮልን ወደ አሜሪካ እንዳይገቡ የሚከለክል ትዕዛዝ አስተላልፈዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ካናዳ በአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ ቀደም ሲል ለተጣለው ታክስ ምላሽ ለመስጠት በወሰደችው የገቢ ታሪፍ ምክንያት ነው። ምንም እንኳን ሁለቱም ሀገራት የንግድ አለመግባባቱ የኢኮኖሚ ጉዳት እንዳለው ቢገነዘቡም፣ ችግሩን ለመፍታት የታቀደ አዲስ ድርድር የለም።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolnaald Traamp ergaa dabarsaniin, jalqaba ji’a Fulbaanaatti kan eegalu, oomishoota Kanaadaa kanneen akka konkolaataa, aannanii fi dhugaatii alkoolii gara Ameerikaa galchuu dhorkaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, Kanaadaan oomishoota Ameerikaa irratti gibira kaffaltii ramaddii duraan ture irratti deebii kennuuf jecha gibira dabalataa erga keessee booda. Biyyoonni lameenuu walitti bu’iinsi daldalaa kun miidhaa diinagdee geessisuu hubatanis, hanga ammaa mariin haaraan furata barbaaduuf karoorfame hin jiru.

title: 'Constantly on my mind' - 9/11 agony goes on for bereaved, 25 years on
english: Twenty-five years after the September 11 attacks, families of the victims are still struggling to find closure as the trial for the alleged mastermind, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, has yet to begin. Despite long and slow legal proceedings at Guantanamo Bay, a trial date has finally been set for 2028. Many grieving relatives worry that this date is too far away and that they may not live to see the justice they have been waiting for.
amharic: የሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ ሃያ አምስት ዓመታት ያለፉ ቢሆንም፣ የጥቃቱ አቀናባሪ ተብሎ የሚጠረጠረው ካሊድ ሼክ መሐመድ ክስ ገና ባለመጀመሩ የተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ፍትሕ ለማግኘት አሁንም በመጠባበቅ ላይ ናቸው። በጓንታናሞ ቤይ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲካሄድ የቆየው የቅድመ-ፍርድ ሂደት አድካሚ ቢሆንም፣ በመጨረሻ ለ2028 ዓ.ም የፍርድ ቀን ተቆርጧል። ይሁን እንጂ ብዙዎቹ የሟች ቤተሰቦች ይህ ጊዜ በጣም የራቀ በመሆኑ፣ የፍትሕ ሂደቱን ለማየት በሕይወት የመቆየታቸው ጉዳይ አሳስቧቸዋል።
oromo: Hojiin shororkeessummaa guyyaa 11 Sadaasaa raawwatame waggaa 25 kan lakkoofsiise ta'us, nama ijoo qindeessite jedhamtu Khalid Sheikh Mohammed irratti himannaan seeraa ammayyuu waan hin jalqabneef maatiin miidhamtootaa haqni akka hin argamne yaaddoo qabu. Giddu galeessa waraanaa Guantanamo Bay keessatti adeemsi seeraa baay'ee suuta waan deemef, guyyaan murtii bara 2028 gaafa ga'u ibsameera. Maatiin miidhamtootaa hedduun garuu guyyaan kun baay'ee fagaachuu isaa fi hamma yeroo sanaatti haqni akka kennamu arguuf lubbuun jiraachuu dhiisuu malu jedhanii yaaddoo guddaa qabu.

title: Anti-AfD protesters rally in Cologne after far-right election win
english: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in Cologne to express their opposition to the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party. This protest was organized following the party's significant success in the recent state election in Saxony-Anhalt, where they secured nearly 44 percent of the vote. The march highlights growing public concern regarding the political rise of the AfD in the country.
amharic: በኮሎኝ ከተማ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የአልተርናቲቭ ፎር ጀርመን (AfD) ፓርቲን በመቃወም ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። ይህ ተቃውሞ የተካሄደው ፓርቲው በሳክሶኒ-አንሃልት የክልል ምርጫ ወደ 44 በመቶ የሚጠጋ ድምጽ በማግኘቱ ነው። ሰልፉ የዚህን የቀኝ ዘመም ፓርቲ የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ በመቃወም ህዝቡ ያለውን ስጋት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa Koloonyitti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman paartii mirga-duree AfD mormuun hiriira bahaniiru. Hiriirri kun kan qophaa'e erga paartiin kun filannoo naannoo Saaksanii-Anhaalt irratti sagalee kutaalee 44 ol argatee booda dha. Hiriirri kunis guddina siyaasaa paartii kanaa irratti mormii fi yaaddoo uummataa kan calaqqisu dha.

title: Marco Rubio says US seeks more economic and security ties in Latin America
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is visiting Colombia, Ecuador, and Peru to strengthen economic and security partnerships with key regional allies. The Trump administration aims to finalize new trade agreements while increasing military cooperation to counter China's expanding influence in Latin America. This diplomatic tour highlights a broader strategic push to reassert American interests across the Western Hemisphere.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በላቲን አሜሪካ ከሚገኙ አጋር ሀገራት ጋር ያላቸውን የኢኮኖሚ እና የፀጥታ ትስስር ለማጠናከር ኮሎምቢያን፣ ኢኳዶርን እና ፔሩን እየጎበኙ ነው። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በክልሉ እያደገ የመጣውን የቻይና ተጽዕኖ ለመግታት አዳዲስ የንግድ ስምምነቶችን ለመፈራረም እና ወታደራዊ ትብብርን ለማሳደግ እየሰራ ነው። ይህ ጉብኝት አሜሪካ በምዕራባዊው ንፍቀ ክበብ ያላትን ጥቅም ለማስጠበቅ የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Rubiyoo, biyyoota Laatiin Ameerikaa kanneen akka Kolombiyaa, Ekuadoor fi Peeruu waliin hariiroo diinagdee fi nageenyaa cimsuuf daawwannaa taasisaniiru. Bulchiinsi Traamp, dhiibbaa Chaayinaan naannichatti qabdu hir'isuuf jecha, waliigaltee daldalaa haaraa uumuufi hirmaannaa waraanaa dabaluuf karoora qaba. Daawwannaan kun Ameerikaan naannoo gara dhihaatti dhiibbaa fi faayidaa ishee deebisnee mirkaneeffachuuf kan karoorfattedha.

title: US destroys five Iranian tankers, Iran retaliates with attacks on Jordan
english: The United States military destroyed five Iranian oil tankers following two consecutive missile attacks by Iran on an American warship. In retaliation for these strikes, Iran launched ballistic missiles at the Al Azraq base in Jordan, though Jordanian air defenses intercepted nearly all of them. These hostilities have further intensified regional tensions, leading to increased global oil prices and threats of additional strikes on ships in the Gulf.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ በጦር መርከቧ ላይ የሚሳይል ጥቃት በመሰንዘሩ ምክንያት አምስት የኢራን የነዳጅ መርከቦችን አውድሟል። ኢራንም ለዚህ ምላሽ በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኘው የአል አዝራቅ ጣቢያ ላይ የሚሳይል ጥቃት የከፈተች ሲሆን፣ የዮርዳኖስ የአየር መከላከያ ስርዓት አብዛኞቹን ሚሳይሎች መትቶ መጣል ችሏል። ይህ ግጭት በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት በማባባስ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲጨምር እና በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ ለሚገኙ መርከቦች ተጨማሪ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnootni waraana Ameerikaa dooniiwwan boba'aa Iraan shan erga weeraraan booda, Iraan gamashee murtii haaloo bahuuf jechuun buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Al-Azraq kan biyya Yordaanos keessatti argamu irratti misaa'elaan haleelteetti. Haa ta'u malee, sirni ittisa qilleensaa Yordaanos misaa'eloota kana keessaa hedduu isaa fashalsiisuu danda'eera. Walitti bu'iinsi kun naannichatti muddama uumeera, akkasumas gatii boba'aa addunyaa dabaluun dooniiwwan bishaan sana keessa jiran irratti soda guddaa uumeera.

title: Suspected smugglers on trial over deadliest migrant tragedy in France
english: A trial has started in Paris for 14 individuals accused of smuggling migrants in connection with a 2021 disaster in the English Channel that killed 31 people. Prosecutors claim the suspects used an overcrowded, unsafe boat that capsized while attempting to reach the UK. The victims, who came from several different countries, drowned after officials reportedly failed to respond effectively to multiple distress signals.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በ2021 በእንግሊዝ ቻናል በተፈጠረ የ31 ስደተኞች ሞት ምክንያት በፓሪስ 14 ተጠርጣሪዎች ላይ ክስ መመስረቱ ተሰማ። አቃቤ ህጎች እንደሚሉት ተከሳሾቹ ስደተኞቹን አደገኛ እና ለጉዞ ብቁ ባልሆነ ጀልባ በማጓጓዝ ለሞት ዳርገዋቸዋል። ከተለያዩ አገራት የተውጣጡት ተጎጂዎች የእርዳታ ጥሪ ቢያቀርቡም የፈረንሳይ እና የእንግሊዝ ባለስልጣናት በአግባቡ ምላሽ ባለመስጠታቸው አደጋው ሊከሰት ችሏል።
oromo: Hojiin seeraa namoota 14 irratti banamee jira; namoonni kunis bara 2021 galaana Ingilizitti godaantota 31 lubbuu dabarsan jedhamanii himataman. Himatamaan kun godaantota doonii baay'ee guuttee fi nageenya hin qabneen gara UK erguuf yaaluun isaanii ibsameera. Miidhamtoonni biyyoota gara garaa irraa dhufan kun yeroo gargaarsa gaafatanii fi amansiisanitti, mootummoonni Faransaayii fi UK gargaarsa barbaachisu gochuu dhabuun isaanii balaa kana akka hammaatu godheera.
